source.title: ARAM: Mayhem/Augments
source.changes: Main effect text extracted; markup and supplementary notes/tables omitted; icon-only gold and melee/ranged labels converted to text.

translation.changes: Simplified Chinese translation of the captured English main-effect excerpts; original values and limitations retained.

1205.name: ADAPt
1205.description: 将所有额外攻击力转化为法术强度，每 0.6 额外攻击力转化为 1 法术强度。此外，法术强度提高 15%。
1205.sourceDescription: Convert all of your bonus attack damage into ability power at a rate of 1 ability power per 0.6 bonus attack damage. Additionally, increase your ability power by 15%.

1141.name: All For You
1141.description: 你对友方英雄施加的治疗和护盾效果提高 30%。
1141.sourceDescription: Your heals and shields on allied champions are increased in effectiveness by 30%.

1002.name: Apex Inventor
1002.description: 获得 100 装备急速，相当于装备冷却缩减 50%。
1002.sourceDescription: Grants 100 item haste, which is equivalent to 50% cooldown reduction for items.

2087.name: Archmage
2087.description: 每当你施放一个技能，随机选取另一个技能，使其冷却时间减少本次施放技能冷却时间的 30%。
2087.sourceDescription: Whenever you cast an ability, refund the cooldown of another, randomly selected ability by 30% of the casted ability's cooldown.

1004.name: Back to Basics
1004.description: 你的英雄技能造成的伤害提高 35%，并获得 70 技能急速以及来自所有来源的治疗和护盾效果提升 35%，但你的终极技能将被永久封印。
1004.sourceDescription: Your champion abilities deal 35% increased damage and you gain 70 ability haste and 35% increased healing and shielding from all sources, but your ultimate ability is permanently sealed.

2103.name: From Downtown
2103.description:
任务：在命中时与敌方英雄相距至少 600 距离的情况下，用技能命中他们 15 次（每次施法对每名英雄最多计为 1 次命中）。

奖励：完成任务后，若技能命中敌方英雄时你与其相距至少 600 距离，会向其当前位置发射一颗流星。流星落地时，对范围内敌人造成 75 – 200（基于等级）（+ 50% 额外攻击力）（+ 20% 法术强度）魔法伤害（每次施法对每个目标有 8 秒冷却时间）。流星伤害与半径随技能命中时你与目标的距离而提高：伤害提高 0% – 230%，半径为 150 – 1708.6。

流星最大伤害为 172.5 – 460（基于等级）（+ 115% 额外攻击力）（+ 46% 法术强度）。
2103.sourceDescription:
Quest: Hit enemy champions with abilities while located at least 600 units away from them (at the time of the hit) 15 times (counts up to 1 hit per champion per cast instance).

Reward: Upon completing your Quest, hitting enemy champions with abilities while located at least 600 units away from them at the time of the hit fires a meteor to their current location, which upon landing deals 75 – 200 (based on level) (+ 50% bonus AD) (+ 20% AP) magic damage to enemies within the area (8 second cooldown per target per cast instance). The meteor's damage and radius are increased based on your distance to the target at the time of the ability hit, increasing its damage by 0% – 230% and setting its radius to 150 – 1708.6 units.

Maximum meteor damage is 172.5 – 460 (based on level) (+ 115% bonus AD) (+ 46% AP).

1180.name: Big Brain
1180.description: 获得可吸收相当于 300% 法术强度伤害的护盾，持续到被打破。复活时及每 70 秒补充该护盾。
1180.sourceDescription: Gain a shield that absorbs damage equal to 300% AP and lasts until destroyed. Shield is replenished upon respawn and every 70 seconds.

1006.name: Blade Waltz
1006.description:
将一个召唤师技能替换为利刃华尔兹。

利刃华尔兹：闪烁至目标敌方英雄处。在接下来的 1.75 秒内，每隔 0.25 秒闪烁至最近的另一名敌方英雄处，最多额外闪烁 7 次。最后一次闪烁以最初目标为目标。每次闪烁至敌人处时，对其造成 30 – 150（基于等级）（+ 10% 额外攻击力）（+ 6% 法术强度）物理伤害，并以 50% 效能施加攻击特效；总伤害最高为 180 – 900（基于等级）（+ 60% 额外攻击力）（+ 36% 法术强度）（冷却时间 45 秒）。

利刃华尔兹生效期间，你处于不可被选取状态且无法行动。附近没有可闪烁至的有效目标时，效果提前结束。若范围内没有其他有效目标，可多次闪烁至同一名敌人处。
1006.sourceDescription:
Replace a summoner spell with Blade Waltz.

Blade Waltz: Blink to the target enemy champion. You then blink to the nearest other enemy champion every 0.25 seconds over the next 1.75 seconds, blinking up to 7 additional times. The last blink targets the primary target. Each time you blink to an enemy, deal 30 – 150 (based on level) (+ 10% bonus AD) (+ 6% AP) physical damage to them and apply on-hit effects at 50% effectiveness, up to a total of 180 – 900 (based on level) (+ 60% bonus AD) (+ 36% AP) (45 second cooldown).

While Blade Waltz is active, you are untargetable and unable to act. This effect will end prematurely if there are no longer any nearby valid targets to blink to. An enemy can be blinked to more than once if there are no other valid targets in range.

1103.name: Bread And Butter
1103.description: 你的第一个基础技能（Q）获得 100 技能急速。
1103.sourceDescription: Your champion's first basic ability (Q) gains 100 ability haste.

1151.name: Bread And Cheese
1151.description: 你的第三个基础技能（E）获得 100 技能急速。
1151.sourceDescription: Your champion's third basic ability (E) gains 100 ability haste.

1150.name: Bread And Jam
1150.description: 你的第二个基础技能（W）获得 100 技能急速。
1150.sourceDescription: Your champion's second basic ability (W) gains 100 ability haste.

1011.name: Can't Touch This
1011.description: 施放终极技能后获得 2 秒无敌（冷却时间 8 秒）。
1011.sourceDescription: Casting your ultimate grants you invulnerability for 2 seconds (8 second cooldown).

1013.name: Celestial Body
1013.description: 获得 1500 额外生命值，但造成的伤害降低 10%。
1013.sourceDescription: Gain 1500 bonus health, but reduce your damage output by 10%.

1015.name: Circle of Death
1015.description: 你产生的治疗和生命回复会对 1000 距离内最近的敌方英雄造成相当于回复量 70% 的魔法伤害。
1015.sourceDescription: Healing and health regeneration you do causes you to deal 70% of that value in magic damage to the nearest enemy champion within 1000 units.

1310.name: Clown College
1310.description:
获得萨科的背刺、欺诈魔术和幻像的爆炸效果。将一个召唤师技能替换为欺诈魔术。

被动——背刺：从敌人背后进行普通攻击时，攻击特效额外造成 20 – 35（基于等级）（+ 50% 额外攻击力）（+ 35% 法术强度）物理伤害。

主动——欺诈魔术：进入隐形状态，最多持续 3 秒，并在 0.125 秒延迟后闪烁至 400 距离内的目标位置。隐形期间的下一次普通攻击额外造成 100（+ 150% 额外攻击力）（+ 55% 法术强度）物理伤害；若触发背刺，则提高至 155（+ 232.5% 额外攻击力）（+ 85.25% 法术强度）额外物理伤害（冷却时间 45 秒）。

被动——幻像死亡：死亡时，在死亡位置周围 350 半径内引发爆炸，对范围内敌人造成相当于其最大生命值 25% 的真实伤害。此外，在死亡位置放置一个魔盒，立即恐惧附近敌人 1 秒。该魔盒不会攻击，持续 3 秒。
1310.sourceDescription:
Gain Shaco's Backstab, Deceive and Hallucinate's explosion. Replace a summoner spell with Deceive.

Passive - Backstab: Your basic attacks deal 20 – 35 (based on level) (+ 50% bonus AD) (+ 35% AP) bonus physical damage on-hit when hitting an enemy from behind.

Active - Deceive: Become invisible for up to 3 seconds and blink to the target location within 400 units after a 0.125-second delay. Your next basic attack while in stealth deals 100 (+ 150% bonus AD) (+ 55% AP) bonus physical damage, increased to「 155 (+ 232.5% bonus AD) (+ 85.25% AP) bonus physical damage 」if Backstab was applied (45 second cooldown).

Passive - Hallucinate Death: Upon your death, release an explosion in a 350 radius of your death location, dealing true damage equal to 25% of target's maximum health to enemies within the area. Additionally, you deploy a box at the location of your death that instantly fears nearby enemies for 1 second. This box does not attack but lasts for 3 seconds.

1018.name: Courage of the Colossus
1018.description: 定身或缚地敌方英雄时，获得持续 3 秒的护盾，可吸收 150 – 450（基于等级）（+ 4% 最大生命值）伤害（每次施法有 5 秒冷却时间）。多次触发产生的护盾可以叠加，但不会刷新先前护盾的持续时间。
1018.sourceDescription: Immobilizing or grounding an enemy champion grants a shield for 3 seconds that absorbs 150 – 450 (based on level) (+ 4% maximum health) damage (5 second cooldown per cast instance). Shields can stack between multiple triggers of this effect, though not refreshing the duration of previous shields.

1118.name: Critical Healing
1118.description: 你的治疗和护盾现在有等于暴击几率的概率使效果提高 40%（每次施法有 5 秒冷却时间）。此外，获得 25% 暴击几率。
1118.sourceDescription: Your heals and shields now have a chance equal to your critical strike chance to increase in effectiveness by 40% (5 second cooldown per cast instance). Additionally, gain 25% critical strike chance.

1323.name: Cruelty
1323.description:
定身或缚地敌方英雄时，在其上方召唤一颗彗星。彗星在 1 秒后落于其届时所在位置，对 300 半径内敌人造成 50 – 150（基于等级）（+ 40% 法术强度）（+ 4% 你的最大生命值）魔法伤害（每次施法有 6 秒冷却时间）。

若通过强制位移触发，彗星会在位移终点召唤。
1323.sourceDescription:
Immobilizing or grounding an enemy champion summons a comet above them that lands at their current location after 1 second, dealing 50 – 150 (based on level) (+ 40% AP) (+ 4% of your maximum health) magic damage to enemies within a 300 radius (6 second cooldown per cast instance).

For displacement effects, the comet will be summoned at the displacement's end location.

1019.name: Dashing
1019.description: 带有冲刺或闪烁的技能获得 175 技能急速。
1019.sourceDescription: Abilities with dashes or blinks gain 175 ability haste.

1020.name: Dawnbringer's Resolve
1020.description: 生命值降至最大生命值的 50% 以下时，在 3 秒内回复相当于最大生命值 30% 的生命值（冷却时间 45 秒，死亡时重置）。
1020.sourceDescription: Upon dropping below 50% maximum health, you are healed for「 30% of your maximum health 」over 3 seconds (45 second cooldown, reset upon death).

1022.name: Deft
1022.description: 获得 60% 额外攻击速度。

1025.name: Dive Bomber
1025.description: 死亡时引发爆炸，对 500 距离内敌人造成相当于目标最大生命值 20% 的真实伤害。
1025.sourceDescription: Upon death, you explode to deal true damage equal to 20% of the target's maximum health to enemies within 500 units.

2099.name: Rite of Ascension
2099.description: 对敌方英雄造成伤害后的 3 秒内参与击杀，会使其留下持续 8 秒的精魄。你可以在 400 距离内对精魄进行普通攻击来吸收它：经过 1.25 秒准备后闪烁至精魄位置，准备期间不可被选取（防御塔除外）、免疫位移且无法行动。吸收精魄后，获得 100% 额外移动速度，在 2 秒内衰减；回复 75 – 300（基于等级）（+ 50% 额外攻击力）（+ 25% 法术强度）生命值，并重置基础技能的冷却时间。治疗量提高 0% – 100%（基于已损失生命值），最高为 150 – 600（基于等级）（+ 100% 额外攻击力）（+ 50% 法术强度）。
2099.sourceDescription: Scoring a takedown against an enemy champion within 3 seconds of damaging them causes them to leave behind their Essence for 8 seconds. You can basic attack the Essence within 400 units to consume it: causing you to blink to its location after winding up for 1.25 seconds, during which you are untargetable (except to turrets), displacement immune, and unable to act. Upon consumption of the Essence, you gain 100% bonus movement speed decaying over 2 seconds, heal yourself for 75 – 300 (based on level) (+ 50% bonus AD) (+ 25% AP), and reset the cooldowns of your basic abilities. The heal is increased by 0% – 100% (based on your missing health), for a maximum heal of 150 – 600 (based on level) (+ 100% bonus AD) (+ 50% AP).

1301.name: Divine Intervention
1301.description: 自动施放塔里克的宇宙之辉，召唤一颗保护之星，经过 2.5 秒降临。随后，你和 400 距离内的所有友方英雄获得 2.5 秒无敌（冷却时间 35 秒）。
1301.sourceDescription: Automatically cast Taric's Cosmic Radiance, calling down a protective star upon you that descends over 2.5 seconds. Afterwards, you and all allied champions within 400 units become invulnerable for 2.5 seconds (35 second cooldown).

1026.name: Don't Blink
1026.description: 你的移动速度每比目标高 10，造成的伤害就提高 1%。
1026.sourceDescription: Deal 1% increased damage per 10 movement speed you have more than the target.

2010.name: Double Tap
2010.description: 产生暴击的普通攻击会额外施加一次攻击特效。此外，获得 25% 暴击几率。
2010.sourceDescription: Basic attacks that critically strike apply on-hit effects an additional time. Additionally, gain 25% critical strike chance.

1134.name: Draw Your Sword
1134.description:
变为近战，将攻击距离修改为 200（+ 100% 来自符文的额外攻击距离）。此外，获得 24% 额外攻击力、20% 额外攻击速度、24% 额外生命值、20% 额外移动速度和 20% 生命偷取。这些加成提高 0% – 100%（基于英雄的默认攻击距离）。

此符文仅向远程英雄提供。
1134.sourceDescription:
Become melee melee, modifying your attack range to 200 (+ 100% bonus attack range from augments) units. Additionally, gain 24% bonus attack damage, 20% bonus attack speed, 24% bonus health, 20% bonus movement speed, and 20% life steal. These bonuses are increased by 0% – 100% (based on champion's default attack range).

This augment is only available for ranged ranged champions.

2031.name: DropBear
2031.description:
死亡时召唤提伯斯，从上方坠落并在 0.5 秒内落至你的死亡位置。落地时，对附近敌人造成 250 – 750（基于等级）（+ 100% 法术强度）（每 1 固定法术穿透 + 2）（每 1% 法术穿透 + 5）魔法伤害，并使其晕眩 1.5 秒。随后提伯斯追逐并锁定击杀你的敌方英雄，进入攻击范围后对其攻击。

提伯斯拥有你的所有符文（此符文除外），最多持续 8 – 20（基于等级）秒。他获得 80% – 100%（基于等级）额外攻击速度，并每秒对周围 350 距离内敌人造成 25 – 150（基于等级）（+ 50% 法术强度）魔法伤害。他的属性如下：

1000 – 6500（基于等级）（+ 15% 最大生命值）（+ 150% 法术强度）生命值（存在期间快速衰减）

50 – 300（基于等级）（+ 75% 攻击力）物理伤害（普通攻击伤害）

1.00 攻击速度

150 攻击距离

50 护甲

50 魔法抗性

200 – 300（基于等级）（+ 20% 移动速度）移动速度
2031.sourceDescription:
Upon death, you summon Tibbers who drops from above and lands onto the location of your death over 0.5 seconds. Upon landing, he deals 250 – 750 (based on level) (+ 100% AP) (+ 2 per 1 flat magic penetration) (+ 5 per 1% magic penetration) magic damage to nearby enemies and stuns them for 1.5 seconds. Tibbers then chases after and targets the enemy champion that killed you, attacking them once he is in range.

Tibbers has all of your augments (excluding DropBear) and lasts for up to 8 – 20 (based on level) seconds. He gains 80% – 100% (based on level) bonus attack speed and deals 25 – 150 (based on level) (+ 50% AP) magic damage every second to enemies within 350 units of him. His stats are:

1000 – 6500 (based on level) (+ 15% maximum health) (+ 150% AP) health (rapidly decays over his lifetime)

50 – 300 (based on level) (+ 75% AD) physical damage (basic attack damage)

1.00 attack speed

150 attack range

50 armor

50 magic resistance

200 – 300 (based on level) (+ 20% movement speed) movement speed

2006.name: Dropkick
2006.description:
普通攻击和技能会处决生命值低于最大生命值 4%（每 100 基础攻击力 + 5.5%）（每 1000 额外生命值 + 1%）的敌方英雄，并将其尸体沿直线踢飞。尸体撞到敌方英雄或地形时会爆炸，对附近敌人造成 150 – 500（基于等级）（+ 100% 额外护甲）（+ 100% 额外魔法抗性）魔法伤害。成功处决会为你回复 100 – 300（基于等级）（+ 25% 额外生命值）生命值。

爆炸也能触发处决，且处决无视护盾。
2006.sourceDescription:
Your basic attacks and abilities execute enemy champions below 4% (+ 5.5% per 100 base AD) (+ 1% per 1000 bonus health) of their maximum health, which causes their corpse to be sent flying away in a line. Upon collision with an enemy champion or terrain, the target's corpse explodes to deal 150 – 500 (based on level) (+ 100% bonus armor) (+ 100% bonus magic resistance) magic damage to nearby enemies. Successful executions heal you for 100 – 300 (based on level) (+ 25% bonus health).

The execution may also be triggered by the explosion and ignores shields.

1225.name: Dual Wield
1225.description: 你的普通攻击会在发动攻击后延迟 0.225 秒向目标发射一枚弹体，造成相当于触发攻击减伤前伤害 40% 的伤害，并以 40% 效能施加攻击特效。此外，总攻击速度提高 10%。
1225.sourceDescription: Your basic attacks launch a bolt at the target that fires after a 0.225-second delay on-attack, deals 40% of the triggering attack's pre-mitigation damage, and applies on-hit effects at 40% effectiveness. Additionally, increase your total attack speed by 10%.

1027.name: Earthwake
1027.description:
冲刺或闪烁会在出发点到终点之间留下轨迹，0.75 秒后在 300 半径内引爆。每次爆炸对命中敌人造成 90 – 250（基于等级）（+ 125% 额外攻击力）（+ 60% 法术强度）物理伤害，对小兵的伤害降至 70%。同一敌人每秒最多受所有施法实例中的一次爆炸影响；若冲刺或闪烁距离超过 2000，则不触发该效果。

每局比赛中，每支队伍最多有 2 名玩家可获得此符文选项。
1027.sourceDescription:
Dashing or blinking causes you to leave behind a trail from the location you moved to your destination that detonates after 0.75 seconds in a 300 radius, dealing 90 – 250 (based on level) (+ 125% bonus AD) (+ 60% AP) physical damage per explosion to enemies hit, reduced to 70% against minions. Enemies can be affected only once every second from all cast instances, and the effect is not triggered if you move beyond 2000 units with the dash or blink.

This augment is only offered to up to 2 players on each team for a given game.

2004.name: Empowered By The Faithful
2004.description: 对友方英雄施加治疗或护盾会赐福其 8 秒。被赐福的友军每次对敌方英雄造成伤害时，你获得一层虔诚，最多叠加 50 层。达到最大层数后，释放冲击波，对附近敌人造成 50 – 300（基于等级）（+ 750% 治疗和护盾强度）魔法伤害。若敌方英雄受伤后的生命值百分比低于你治疗和护盾强度的 25%，则将其处决。
2004.sourceDescription: Granting a heal or shield to an allied champion blesses them for 8 seconds. Whenever a blessed ally damages an enemy champion, you generate a stack of Devotion, stacking up to 50 times. Upon reaching maximum stacks, you unleash a shockwave that deals 50 – 300 (based on level) (+ 750% heal and shield power) magic damage to nearby enemies. Enemy champions damaged below a percentage of their maximum health equal to 25% of your heal and shield power are executed.

2098.name: En Passant
2098.description:
你可以识别 2000 距离内敌方英雄的破绽，以围绕他们并朝向特定方向的弧形标记表示。面朝目标暴露的破绽方向，用普通攻击或技能对其造成伤害，会消耗破绽，额外造成目标最大生命值 6%（每层此符文效果 + 1.5%）的真实伤害，为你回复 50 – 200（基于等级）（+ 5% 已损失生命值）生命值，并提供 50%（每层此符文效果 + 5%）额外移动速度，在 2 秒内衰减。消耗破绽还会获得持续 8 秒的一层效果，后续触发破绽会刷新持续时间，可叠加若干层。每层都会提高破绽伤害和额外移动速度。

进入范围后，目标破绽立即暴露，并一直保持到你死亡。消耗目标破绽后，会在 4 秒后识别其另一个破绽，方向与上一个不同。
2098.sourceDescription:
You can now identify the Vitals of enemy champions within 2000 units, marked as an arc around them and pointing towards a specific direction. Dealing damage to a target with a basic attack or ability while you are facing in the direction of their exposed Vital will consume it, dealing bonus true damage equal to 6% (+ 1.5% per En Passant stack) of the target's maximum health, healing you for 50 – 200 (based on level) (+ 5% missing health), and granting you 50% (+ 5% per En Passant stack) bonus movement speed that decays over 2 seconds. Consuming a target's Vital also grants you an En Passant stack for 8 seconds, refreshing on subsequent Vital triggers and stacking up a number of times. Each En Passant stack increases the consumed Vital damage and bonus movement speed.

Vitals on targets become exposed instantly once you are within range and remain exposed until you die. Once a target's Vital is consumed, you identify a new Vital on them pointing in a different direction from the previous after 4 seconds.

1028.name: Erosion
1028.description: 每次对敌人造成伤害，都会使其护甲和魔法抗性降低 1.5%，持续 4 秒，最多叠加 20 层，共降低 30% 双抗。
1028.sourceDescription: Each instance of damage dealt to an enemy reduces their armor and magic resistance by 1.5% for 4 seconds, stacking up to 20 times for a total of 30% resistances reduction.

1029.name: Ethereal Weapon
1029.description: 你的技能会施加攻击特效（对每个目标的冷却时间为 1 秒）。
1029.sourceDescription: Your abilities apply on-hit effects (1 second cooldown per target).

1030.name: Eureka
1030.description: 获得相当于 30% 法术强度的技能急速。
1030.sourceDescription: Gain ability haste equal to 30% AP.

1220.name: Fan the Hammer
1220.description: 在你周围 750 距离内的四个基本方向上，你对敌方英雄的下一次普通攻击会在发动攻击时额外向目标发射 5 枚飞弹。每枚造成 8 – 51（基于等级）（+ 14% 额外攻击力）物理伤害，总计 40 – 255（基于等级）（+ 70% 额外攻击力）物理伤害（每个方向的冷却时间为 5 秒）。飞弹伤害提高 0% – 50%（基于飞行距离）。每枚飞弹都可暴击，造成（200% + 30%）伤害，并以 20% 效能施加攻击特效。
1220.sourceDescription: Your next basic attack against an enemy champion in each cardinal direction within 750 range additionally on-attack fires 5 missiles at the target that each deal 8 – 51 (based on level) (+ 14% bonus AD) physical damage, for a total of 40 – 255 (based on level) (+ 70% bonus AD) physical damage (5 second cooldown per direction). Missiles' damage is increased by 0% – 50% (based on distance travelled). Each missile can critically strike for (200% + 30%) damage and applies on-hit effects at 20% effectiveness.

1194.name: Fey Magic
1194.description: 终极技能对敌人造成伤害时，将其变形为无害的小动物，持续 2 秒，期间基础移动速度降低 60，并被缴械相同时间（每个目标的冷却时间为 15 秒）。
1194.sourceDescription: Damaging enemies with your ultimate ability polymorphs them into harmless critters for 2 seconds, during which their base movement speed is reduced by 60, and disarms them for the same duration (15 second cooldown per target).

1036.name: Firebrand
1036.description: 普通攻击施加持续 5 秒的灼烧，每秒额外造成相当于目标最大生命值 0.4% 的魔法伤害。灼烧可无限叠加，每次施加都会刷新持续时间。
1036.sourceDescription: Basic attacks apply a Burn for 5 seconds that deals bonus magic damage equal to「 0.4% of the target's maximum health per second. 」This Burn stacks infinitely and refreshes with each application.

1308.name: Firefox
1308.description: 自动施放改版的阿狸妖异狐火：获得 25% 额外移动速度，在 2 秒内衰减；召唤 3 团火焰，以 150 半径顺时针环绕你，最多持续 2.5 秒。火焰会飞向 550 距离内最近的可见敌人，造成 35 – 160（基于等级）（+ 25% 额外攻击力）（+ 25% 法术强度）自适应伤害；同次施法的后续火焰对同一敌人的伤害降至 10.5 – 48（基于等级）（+ 7.5% 额外攻击力）（+ 7.5% 法术强度）（冷却时间 7 秒）。
1308.sourceDescription: Automatically cast a modified version of Ahri's Fox-Fire, gaining 25% bonus movement speed that decays over 2 seconds and conjuring 3 flames that orbit you clockwise for up to 2.5 seconds at a radius of 150 units. The flames will fly toward the nearest visible enemies within 550 units, dealing 35 – 160 (based on level) (+ 25% bonus AD (+ 25% AP) adaptive damage, reduced to「 10.5 – 48 (based on level) (+ 7.5% bonus AD (+ 7.5% AP) 」for enemies hit by subsequent flames from the same cast (7 second cooldown).

1037.name: First-Aid Kit
1037.description: 获得 20% 治疗和护盾强度。

1187.name: Flashbang
1187.description:
使用闪现会在闪烁落点周围引发爆炸，对附近敌人造成 70 – 240（基于等级）（+ 70% 攻击力）（+ 60% 法术强度）魔法伤害，并使其减速 35%，持续 1.25 秒。此外，死亡时重置闪现冷却时间。

若未携带闪现，会提示你将一个召唤师技能替换为闪现。
1187.sourceDescription:
Using Flash creates an explosion around the blink location that deals 70 – 240 (based on level) (+ 70% AD) (+ 60% AP) magic damage to nearby enemies and slows them by 35% for 1.25 seconds. Additionally, the cooldown of your Flash resets upon your death.

If Flash is not equipped, you will be prompted to replace one of your summoner spells with Flash.

1116.name: Flashy
1116.description:
闪现现在有 3 层充能，两次施放之间有 2 秒冷却时间（全部 3 层充能的回复时间为 120 秒）。

若未携带闪现，会提示你将一个召唤师技能替换为闪现。
1116.sourceDescription:
Your Flash now has 3 charges with a 2-second cooldown between casts (120 seconds recharge time for all 3 charges).

If Flash is not equipped, you will be prompted to replace one of your summoner spells with Flash.

1038.name: From Beginning to End
1038.description: 获得黑暗收割和先攻基石符文。
1038.sourceDescription: Gain the Dark Harvest and First Strike keystone runes.

1322.name: Get Excited
1322.description: 参与击杀英雄后，获得 100% 额外移动速度和 15% 总攻击速度，持续 4 秒。
1322.sourceDescription: Scoring a champion takedown grants you 100% bonus movement speed and 15% total attack speed for 4 seconds.

1195.name: Giant Slayer
1195.description: 体型缩小 75%，并获得 20% 额外移动速度。此外，对体型比你大的敌方英雄额外造成 10% / 15% / 25% / 30%（基于目标体型）伤害。
1195.sourceDescription: Become tiny, reducing your size by 75% and granting you 20% bonus movement speed. Additionally, deal 10% / 15% / 25% / 30% (based on target's size) bonus damage against enemy champions with greater size than you.

1041.name: Goliath
1041.description: 获得 35% 额外生命值、15% 自适应之力，体型增大 50%。
1041.sourceDescription: Grants 35% bonus health, 15% adaptive force, and 50% increased size.

1181.name: Heavy Hitter
1181.description: 普通攻击额外造成相当于你最大生命值 3.5% 的物理伤害。
1181.sourceDescription: Basic attacks deal bonus physical damage equal to 3.5% of your maximum health.

2107.name: Hellbent
2107.description:
每用普通攻击或技能命中一名敌方英雄，就获得一层效果，持续 6 秒，后续命中刷新持续时间，最多叠加 10 层。满层时进入不屈状态。

不屈：受到致命伤害时，进入持续 4 秒的复活状态，期间无敌、不可被选取且无法行动。随后以最大生命值的 35% – 75%（基于等级）复活（冷却时间 90 秒）。此外，接下来的 15 秒内获得强化，提供 15 – 120（基于等级）额外攻击力或 25 – 200（基于等级）法术强度（自适应）、朝附近敌方英雄移动时获得 20% – 40%（基于等级）额外移动速度，以及 15% – 30%（基于等级）全能吸血。
2107.sourceDescription:
Generate a stack of Revivemaxxing for each enemy champion you hit with basic attacks or abilities, lasting for 6 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits, and stacking up to 10 times. At maximum stacks, you become Hellbent.

Hellbent: Upon taking lethal damage, you enter resurrection for 4 seconds, during which you are invulnerable, untargetable, and unable to act. Afterwards, you revive with 35% – 75% (based on level) of your maximum health (90 second cooldown). Additionally, you become empowered for the next 15 seconds, granting you 15 – 120 (based on level) bonus Attack Damage or 25 – 200 (based on level) Ability Power (Adaptive), 20% – 40% (based on level) bonus movement speed while facing toward nearby enemy champions, and 15% – 30% (based on level) omnivamp for the duration.

2095.name: High Roller
2095.description: 附近敌人死亡时，有 0.5% 几率在死亡位置掉落属性锻造器；非英雄单位的几率降至 0.25%。走过掉落的锻造器即可拾取。获得的属性锻造器会在商店再次可用时（你死亡后）消耗。
2095.sourceDescription: Nearby enemies that die have a 0.5% chance to drop a Stat Anvil at the location of their death, reduced to a 0.25% chance for non-champions. You can pick up dropped anvils by moving over them. The obtained Stat Anvils will be consumed once the shop is enabled again (after your death).

1105.name: Homeguard
1105.description: 获得 100% 额外移动速度。受到伤害后，此加成失效 6 秒。
1105.sourceDescription: Gain 100% bonus movement speed. This bonus is lost for 6 seconds after taking damage.

1044.name: Ice Cold
1044.description: 你的减速效果会额外降低目标 75 移动速度。
1044.sourceDescription: Your slowing effects reduce the movement speed of targets by an additional 75.

1001.name: Titan's Resolve
1001.description:
每次造成或受到伤害（持续伤害除外）时获得一层效果，持续 6 秒，后续造成或受到伤害会刷新持续时间。每 10 层提供 15 – 45（基于等级）额外攻击力或 25 – 75（基于等级）法术强度（自适应）、5 – 10（基于等级）额外护甲和额外魔法抗性、体型增大 10%，以及 8% 韧性。

持续时间结束后，层数逐层消失；层数越多，衰减越快。
1001.sourceDescription:
You generate a stack of Juggernauting for each instance of damage you deal or take (excluding damage over time), lasting for 6 seconds and refreshing on subsequent damage dealt or taken. For every 10 stacks of Juggernauting, you gain 15 – 45 (based on level) bonus Attack Damage or 25 – 75 (based on level) Ability Power (Adaptive), 5 – 10 (based on level) bonus armor and bonus magic resistance, 10% increased size, and 8% tenacity.

Stacks expire one by one when the duration ends, with the decay rate being faster the more stacks you have.

1149.name: Impassable
1149.description: 获得余震和冰川增幅基石符文。
1149.sourceDescription: Gain the Aftershock and Glacial Augment keystone runes.

1045.name: Infernal Conduit
1045.description:
你的技能命中英雄时施加持续 3 秒的灼烧，每秒额外造成 2 – 20（基于等级）（+ 4.6% 额外攻击力）（+ 2% 法术强度）魔法伤害（每次施法有 1 秒冷却时间）。灼烧可无限叠加，每次施加都会刷新持续时间。

此外，你的所有灼烧效果每对一个目标造成一次伤害，都会使所有基础技能的冷却时间减少 0.08 秒。
1045.sourceDescription:
Your ability hits against champions apply a Burn for 3 seconds that deals「 2 – 20 (based on level) (+ 4.6% bonus AD) (+ 2% AP) bonus magic damage per second 」(1 second cooldown per cast instance). This Burn stacks infinitely and refreshes with each application.

Additionally, all of your Burn effects reduce the cooldowns of all your basic abilities by 0.08 seconds for each tick of damage they deal to a target.

1046.name: Infernal Soul
1046.description: 获得炼狱龙魂；若已拥有，则获得另一种龙魂。
1046.sourceDescription: Grants the Infernal Dragon Soul, or a different Dragon Soul if you aleady have it.

2005.name: Triggered Inferno
2005.description:
用普通攻击或技能对敌方英雄造成伤害时，若至少命中一名与上次对英雄造成伤害时不同的敌方英雄，就获得一层格调，持续 6 秒。后续命中相同或不同目标都会刷新持续时间，最多叠加 7 层。每层提供 4.25% / 4.5% / 4.75% / 5%（基于等级）额外移动速度，最高为 29.75% / 31.5% / 33.25% / 35%（基于等级）。

达到最大格调层数后，释放持续 2.277 秒的弹幕，其中在 2.013 秒内以每 0.2 秒为间隔的不规则时机快速射击附近敌人（每名敌人最多被射击 10 次）。每发造成 20 – 40（基于等级）（+ 40% 攻击力）（+ 25% 法术强度）物理伤害，对小兵的伤害降低 75%。对生命值低于最大生命值 30% 的敌人，射击会暴击并造成双倍伤害（冷却时间 15 秒）。受到阻止施法的控制效果时，此效果提前结束。

格调层数以评级表示（→→→→→→）。射击效果结束时消耗层数。射击伤害可触发生命偷取。
2005.sourceDescription:
Your damaging basic attacks and abilities against at least one enemy champion unique from the previous damaging hit made against champions generate a stack of Style for 6 seconds, refreshing on subsequent unique or non-unique hits and stacking up to 7 times. For each stack, gain 4.25% / 4.5% / 4.75% / 5% (based on level) bonus movement speed, up to a maximum of 29.75% / 31.5% / 33.25% / 35% (based on level).

Upon reaching maximum Style stacks, you unleash a torrent of shots for 2.277 seconds, during which you rapidly shoot at nearby enemies over 2.013 seconds at sporadic times in 0.2-second intervals each (up to 10 times per enemy), dealing 20 – 40 (based on level) (+ 40% AD) (+ 25% AP) physical damage with each shot, reduced by 75% against minions. Enemies below 30% of their maximum health are critically struck for「 double damage 」(15 second cooldown). This effect ends prematurely if you become affected by cast-inhibiting crowd control.

Style stacks are represented by grades (→→→→→→). The stacks are consumed at the end of the shooting effect. Shot damage applies life steal.

1211.name: It's Killing Time
1211.description: 施放终极技能时，对所有敌方英雄施加劫的死亡印记（冷却时间 8 秒）。印记储存你对该目标造成的所有减伤后伤害的 40%，在 5 秒后引爆，对其造成等于储存伤害的真实伤害。
1211.sourceDescription: Upon casting your ultimate ability, you apply Zed's Death Mark to all enemy champions (8 second cooldown). The mark stores 40% of all post-mitigation damage you deal to the affected target, detonating after 5 seconds to deal true damage equal to the damage stored against them.

1048.name: Jeweled Gauntlet
1048.description:
你的技能现在可以暴击，造成（145% + 额外暴击伤害）伤害。此外，获得 25%（每 100 法术强度 + 4.5%）暴击几率。

若同时拥有珠光护手和易损，只使用暴击伤害更高的那个符文来判定暴击；若相同，则使用其中任意一个。
1048.sourceDescription:
Your abilities can now critically strike for (145% + bonus critical damage) damage. Additionally, gain 25% (+ 4.5% per 100 AP) critical strike chance.

If both Jeweled Gauntlet and Vulnerability are equipped, only rolls the critical strike chance of the augment that has the higher critical damage (or either if equal).

2016.name: Juiced
2016.description: 对敌方英雄的普通攻击特效会消耗你最大法力值的 2.5%，额外造成相当于你最大法力值 4.5% 的魔法伤害。该伤害可以暴击，额外造成（100% + 30%）伤害。
2016.sourceDescription: Basic attacks on-hit against enemy champions consume 2.5% of your maximum mana to deal bonus magic damage equal to 4.5% of your maximum mana. This damage can critically strike for (100% + 30%) bonus damage.

1305.name: Leg Day
1305.description: 获得 50 额外移动速度和 40% 减速抗性。
1305.sourceDescription: Gain 50 bonus movement speed and 40% slow resist.

1051.name: Light 'em Up!
1051.description: 普通攻击会积累层数，最多 4 层。第四层会消耗所有层数，快速向目标发射 4 枚飞弹，每枚通过攻击特效额外造成 11 – 80（基于等级）（+ 35% 额外攻击力）（+ 19% 法术强度）魔法伤害，总计 44 – 320（基于等级）（+ 140% 额外攻击力）（+ 76% 法术强度）。
1051.sourceDescription: Basic attacks generate a stack, up to 4. The fourth stack consumes them all to quickly launch 4 missiles at the target that each deal 11 – 80 (based on level) (+ 35% bonus AD) (+ 19% AP) bonus magic damage on-hit, for a total of 44 – 320 (based on level) (+ 140% bonus AD) (+ 76% AP).

2007.name: Devil on Your Shoulder
2007.description:
与小恶魔提莫订立契约：每秒失去当前生命值的 0.5%；若 1000 距离内有敌方英雄，则提高至 5%。作为交换，你额外造成 20% 真实伤害，普通攻击和技能还会在附近生成持续 5 秒的生命残片（生成冷却时间 0.75 秒）。走过残片即可吸收，为你回复 50 – 150（基于等级）（+ 50% 额外攻击力）（+ 25% 法术强度）生命值，并获得 15% 额外移动速度。

原文注明：此符文目前已禁用。
2007.sourceDescription:
Forge a pact with Little Devil Teemo, who drains 0.5% of your current health every second, increased to 5% if there are enemy champions within 1000 units. In return, you deal 20% bonus true damage and your basic attacks and abilities summon a Life Remnant nearby for 5 seconds (0.75-second spawn cooldown). You can absorb a Life Remnant by moving over it, healing you for 50 – 150 (based on level) (+ 50% bonus AD) (+ 25% AP) and granting you 15% bonus movement speed.

This augment is currently disabled.

1053.name: Mad Scientist
1053.description: 获得此符文时及每次复活时，随机获得以下一组加成：30% 自适应之力、20% 额外生命值和体型增大 40%；或 70 技能急速、40% 额外移动速度和体型缩小 40%。
1053.sourceDescription: Upon acquiring this augment and each time you respawn, gain either 30% adaptive force, 20% bonus health, and 40% increased size or 70 ability haste, 40% bonus movement speed, and 40% reduced size.

1133.name: Magic Missile
1133.description: 用技能对敌方英雄造成伤害时，向其发射 3 枚飞弹，每枚造成相当于目标最大生命值 0.33% 的真实伤害，并随飞行距离最多提高至 1%（飞行 1000 距离时达到最大伤害）。同一次施法每 6 秒最多触发一次。
1133.sourceDescription: Dealing damage to an enemy champion with an ability fires 3 missiles at them that each deal true damage equal to 0.33% of the target's maximum health, increased to up to 1% based on distance travelled (maximum damage reached at 1000 units). This effect can only trigger once every 6 seconds from the same cast.

1129.name: Marksmage
1129.description: 普通攻击额外造成相当于 75% 法术强度的物理伤害。
1129.sourceDescription: Basic attacks deal bonus physical damage equal to 75% AP.

1054.name: Master of Duality
1054.description: 普通攻击的攻击特效提供 6 – 18（基于等级）法术强度；伤害技能每次施法提供一次 3 – 9（基于等级）额外攻击力。两种加成都持续 5 秒，后续命中同时刷新两者持续时间，可无限叠加。
1054.sourceDescription: Basic attacks on-hit grant 6 – 18 (based on level) ability power and damaging abilities once per cast instance grant 3 – 9 (based on level) bonus attack damage, lasting for 5 seconds, with the duration of both refreshing on subsequent hits, and stacking infinitely.

1056.name: Mind to Matter
1056.description: 获得相当于最大法力值 50% 的额外生命值。
1056.sourceDescription: Grants bonus health equal to 50% maximum mana.

1104.name: Minionmancer
1104.description: 你的召唤物造成的伤害提高 40%，并获得 40% 额外生命值和体型增大。
1104.sourceDescription: Your pets deal 40% increased damage as well as gain 40% bonus health and size.

1057.name: Mountain Soul
1057.description: 获得山脉龙魂；若已拥有，则获得另一种龙魂。
1057.sourceDescription: Grants the Mountain Dragon Soul, or a different Dragon Soul if you aleady have it.

2055.name: Multishot
2055.description:
获得任务：用指定技能的飞弹命中敌方英雄一定次数（每次施法对每名英雄最多计为 1 次命中）。任务共有六个阶段，每完成一个阶段，该技能施放时便额外发射一枚飞弹。奖励效果还会将技能改为以锥形发射所有飞弹。同次施法中，后续飞弹对同一敌人只造成 30% 伤害。

下方原文表格列出的命中次数要求向下取整，最低为 1。
2055.sourceDescription:
Assigns quests that require you to hit enemy champions with a specific ability's missile a number of times (counts up to 1 hit per champion per cast instance). There are six quest tiers, and each completed tier rewards you with an additional missile fired on the ability's cast. The reward effect also modifies the ability to fire all of its missiles in a cone. Subsequent missile hits from the same cast against the same enemy deal 30% damage.

Hit requirements as denoted below are rounded down to whole numbers, with a minimum value of 1.

1058.name: Mystic Punch
1058.description: 普通攻击的攻击特效使你的各个技能的剩余冷却时间减少 1.25 秒。
1058.sourceDescription: Basic attacks on-hit reduce the remaining cooldowns of your abilities by 1.25 seconds.

1060.name: Ocean Soul
1060.description: 获得海洋龙魂，其基础治疗量修改为 100；若已拥有，则获得另一种龙魂。
1060.sourceDescription: Grants the Ocean Dragon Soul, which has a modified base heal value of 100, or a different Dragon Soul if you aleady have it.

1061.name: OK Boomerang
1061.description: 自动朝 1250 距离内最近的敌方英雄施放强化版希维尔回旋之刃，对命中敌人造成 40 – 200（基于等级）（+ 30% 额外攻击力）（+ 20% 法术强度）自适应伤害（冷却时间 10 秒）。
1061.sourceDescription: Automatically cast an improved version of Sivir's Boomerang Blade at the closest nearby enemy champion within 1250 units, dealing 40 – 200 (based on level) (+ 30% bonus AD) (+ 20% AP) adaptive damage to enemies hit (10 second cooldown).

1063.name: Outlaw's Grit
1063.description: 冲刺或闪烁后获得 12 额外护甲和额外魔法抗性，持续 15 秒，最多叠加 5 层，共提供 60 额外双抗，后续触发刷新持续时间。
1063.sourceDescription: Dashing or blinking grants 12 bonus armor and bonus magic resistance for 15 seconds, stacking up to 5 times for a total of 60 bonus resistances, and refreshing on subsequent triggers.

1311.name: Overflow
1311.description: 你的技能法力消耗翻倍，但造成的伤害、对自身及他人施加的治疗和护盾效果提高 10%（每 100 最大法力值 + 0.5%）。
1311.sourceDescription: Your abilities' mana costs are doubled, but you also gain 10% (+ 0.5% per 100 maximum mana) increased damage as well as self and outgoing healing and shielding.

12317.name: Pandora's Box
12317.description: 获得一个随机棱彩符文。此外，将你当前已有的符文变为相同数量、完全随机的棱彩符文。
12317.sourceDescription: Gain one random Prismatic-tier augment. Additionally, your current augments transform into an equal number of completely random Prismatic-tier ones.

1064.name: Perseverance
1064.description:
获得 1000% 基础生命回复；生命值低于最大生命值的 25% 时，提高至 2000%。

原文注明：此符文目前已禁用。
1064.sourceDescription:
Grants 1000% base health regeneration, increased to 2000% while below 25% maximum health.

This augment is currently disabled.

1390.name: Phenomenal Evil
1390.description:
获得维迦的超凡邪力。

超凡邪力：每次以技能伤害对敌方英雄造成伤害，就永久获得一层超凡邪力。该效果全局每秒最多触发一次，同次施法每 3 秒最多触发一次。每层提供 1 法术强度。

若此符文不是你的第一个符文，初始获得 40 层超凡邪力，提供 40 法术强度。
1390.sourceDescription:
Gain Veigar's Phenomenal Evil Power.

Phenomenal Evil Power: Generate a permanent stack of Phenomenal Evil each time you damage an enemy champion with ability damage. This effect cannot trigger more than once every second globally and once every 3 seconds from the same cast instance. For each stack, gain 1 ability power.

If this is not your first augment, start with 40 Phenomenal Evil stacks, granting you 40 ability power.

1324.name: Protein Shake
1324.description: 获得 25%（每 100 额外护甲 + 35%）（每 100 额外魔法抗性 + 35%）治疗和护盾强度。
1324.sourceDescription: Gain 25% (+ 35% per 100 bonus armor) (+ 35% per 100 bonus magic resistance) heal and shield power.

2018.name: Purist - Caster
2018.description: 将所有额外攻击速度转化为技能急速，每 1% 额外攻击速度转化为 0.65 技能急速。此外，你的技能总冷却时间缩短 10%。
2018.sourceDescription: Convert all of your bonus attack speed into ability haste at a rate of 0.65 ability haste per 1% bonus attack speed. Additionally, your abilities' total cooldowns are reduced by 10%.

1066.name: Quantum Computing
1066.description:
当 650 距离内有敌方英雄时，自动施放强化版卡蜜尔战术横扫，蓄力 0.75 秒后横扫周围 650 半径。对范围内敌人造成 200 – 350（基于等级）（+ 75% 额外攻击力）（+ 45% 法术强度）物理伤害（冷却时间 30 秒）。外圈命中的敌人额外受到相当于其最大生命值 10%（每 100 额外攻击力 + 2.5%）（每 100 法术强度 + 1.6%）（每 100 额外生命值 + 0.1%）的物理伤害，并被减速 80%，在 2 秒内衰减。此外，回复相当于外圈命中敌方英雄所造成额外减伤后伤害 80% 的生命值。

原文注明：此符文目前已禁用。
1066.sourceDescription:
Automatically cast an improved version of Camille's Tactical Sweep when an enemy champion is within 650 units of you, winding up over 0.75 seconds to slash in a 650 radius around you. The slash deals 200 – 350 (based on level) (+ 75% bonus AD) (+ 45% AP) physical damage to enemies within the area (30 second cooldown). Enemies hit by the outer edge of the circle take bonus physical damage equal to 10% (+ 2.5% per 100 bonus AD) (+ 1.6% per 100 AP) (+ 0.1% per 100 bonus health) of their maximum health and are slowed by 80% decaying over 2 seconds. Additionally, you are healed for 80% of the bonus post-mitigation damage against enemy champions hit by the outer edge.

This augment is currently disabled.

1152.name: Quest: Steel Your Heart
1152.description:
任务：获得心之钢，并通过庞然吞食累计获得超过 300 额外生命值。

奖励：完成任务后，心之钢的庞然吞食所提供的额外生命值提高 200%。
1152.sourceDescription:
Quest: Obtain Heartsteel and accumulate over 300 bonus health from Colossal Consumption.

Reward: Upon completing your Quest, increase the bonus health gained from Heartsteel's Colossal Consumption by 200%.

1154.name: Quest: Urf's Champion
1154.description:
任务：参与击杀英雄 18 次。

奖励：完成任务后获得金铲铲。

若完成任务时装备栏已满，将在有空装备栏时立即获得该装备。
1154.sourceDescription:
Quest: Score 18 champion takedowns.

Reward: Upon completing your Quest, you receive The Golden Spatula.

If your inventory is full at the time of quest completion, the item will be granted as soon as a slot in the inventory is available.

1361.name: Quest: Icathia's Fall
1361.description:
获得斑比的熔渣。你现在可以无视献祭被动的装备限制，同时购买璀璨回响和日炎圣盾。

任务：获得璀璨回响和日炎圣盾。

奖励：完成任务后，将上述任务装备转化为虚空献祭。
1361.sourceDescription:
Gain Bami's Cinder. You can now purchase Hollow Radiance and Sunfire Aegis in spite of the item limit imposed by Immolate.

Quest: Obtain Hollow Radiance and Sunfire Aegis.

Reward: Upon completing your Quest, convert the items you obtained for the quest into Void Immolation.

1156.name: Quest: Wooglet's Witchcap
1156.description:
获得无用大棒。

任务：获得灭世者的死亡之帽和中娅沙漏。

奖励：完成任务后，将上述任务装备转化为沃格勒特的巫师帽。
1156.sourceDescription:
Gain a Needlessly Large Rod.

Quest: Obtain Rabadon's Deathcap and Zhonya's Hourglass.

Reward: Upon completing your Quest, convert the items you obtained for the quest into Wooglet's Witchcap.

2064.name: Quickstep
2064.description: 升级你的一个英雄技能，施放该技能时会使你朝鼠标位置冲刺，最多移动 350 距离。
2064.sourceDescription: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities, empowering the ability's cast to cause you to dash up to 350 units towards your cursor.

1067.name: Rejuvenation
1067.description: 升级你的一个英雄技能，施放时为你回复 30 – 100（基于等级）（+ 25% 额外攻击力）（+ 15% 法术强度）（+ 5% 额外生命值）生命值。技能冷却时间越长，治疗量越高，最多提高 50%；最大治疗量为 45 – 150（基于等级）（+ 37.5% 额外攻击力）（+ 22.5% 法术强度）（+ 7.5% 额外生命值）。
1067.sourceDescription: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities, empowering the ability's cast to heal you for 30 – 100 (based on level) (+ 25% bonus AD) (+ 15% AP) (+ 5% bonus health). This is increased by up to 50% based on how long the ability's cooldown is, for a maximum heal of 45 – 150 (based on level) (+ 37.5% bonus AD) (+ 22.5% AP) (+ 7.5% bonus health).

1170.name: Scoped Weapons
1170.description: 获得额外攻击距离：近战 75 / 远程 50。

1071.name: Scopier Weapons
1071.description: 获得额外攻击距离：近战 200 / 远程 100。

1115.name: Scopiest Weapons
1115.description: 获得额外攻击距离：近战 250 / 远程 150。

1072.name: Searing Dawn
1072.description:
获得蕾欧娜的日光。

日光：伤害技能会标记敌人，使友军下一次对其命中的普通攻击或技能额外造成 40 – 200（基于等级）魔法伤害（每个目标的冷却时间为 0.75 秒）。
1072.sourceDescription:
Gain Leona's Sunlight.

Sunlight: Your damaging abilities mark enemies, causing them to take 40 – 200 (based on level) bonus magic damage from your ally's next basic attack or ability hit against them (0.75-second cooldown per target).

1073.name: Shadow Runner
1073.description: 冲刺、闪烁或离开潜行状态后，获得 300 额外移动速度，持续 2 秒。
1073.sourceDescription: After dashing, blinking, or exiting stealth, gain 300 bonus movement speed for 2 seconds.

1074.name: Shrink Ray
1074.description: 普通攻击的攻击特效使目标造成的伤害降低 15%，持续 3 秒，每次命中刷新持续时间。期间目标体型也会大幅缩小。
1074.sourceDescription: Basic attacks on-hit reduce the target's damage dealt by 15% for 3 seconds, refreshing with each hit. Their size is also reduced significantly for the duration.

1113.name: Skilled Sniper
1113.description: 用基础技能命中敌方英雄时，若命中时与其相距至少 600 距离，则该技能当前冷却时间减少其总冷却时间的 80%；对持续伤害技能，该比例改为 65%。
1113.sourceDescription: Hitting an enemy champion with a basic ability while located at least 600 units away from them at the time of the hit reduces its current cooldown by 80% of its total cooldown, modified to 65% for damage over time abilities.

1136.name: Slap Around
1136.description: 定身或缚地敌方英雄时，获得 6 额外攻击力或 10 法术强度（自适应），可无限叠加（每次施法有 5 秒冷却时间）。死亡时失去 50% 层数。
1136.sourceDescription: Immobilizing or grounding an enemy champion grants you 6 bonus Attack Damage or 10 Ability Power (Adaptive), stacking infinitely (5 second cooldown per cast instance). Lose 50% of stacks on death.

2088.name: Snowday
2088.description:
标记（雪球）造成的伤害提高 100%，并获得相当于 100 技能急速的冷却缩减。

若未携带标记，会提示你将一个召唤师技能替换为标记。
2088.sourceDescription:
Your Mark deals 100% increased damage and has its cooldown reduced equivalent to 100 ability haste.

If Mark is not equipped, you will be prompted to replace one of your summoner spells with Mark.

1076.name: Sonic Boom
1076.description: 对友军施加增益、治疗或护盾时，对其周围 450 距离内敌人造成 30 – 150（基于等级）真实伤害，并使目标减速 30%，持续 2 秒（冷却时间 2 秒）。
1076.sourceDescription: Granting a buff, heal, or shield to your ally deals 30 – 150 (based on level) true damage to enemies within 450 units of them and slows targets by 30% for 2 seconds (2 second cooldown).

1077.name: Soul Siphon
1077.description: 你的暴击造成减伤后伤害时，回复相当于该伤害 12% 的生命值。此外，获得 25% 暴击几率。
1077.sourceDescription: Heal for 12% of the post-mitigation damage dealt by your critical strikes. Additionally, gain 25% critical strike chance.

2100.name: Pursuit of Haste
2100.description: 获得任务：用指定技能命中敌方英雄一定次数（每次施法对每名英雄最多计为 1 次命中）。任务共有两个阶段，每完成一个阶段，就为该技能提供技能急速。
2100.sourceDescription: Assigns quests that require you to hit enemy champions with a specific ability a number of times (counts up to 1 hit per champion per cast instance). There are two quest tiers, and each completed tier rewards you with ability haste on the ability.

1214.name: Spin To Win
1214.description: 你的旋转技能造成的伤害提高 30%，并获得相当于 30 技能急速的冷却缩减。终极技能的伤害增幅提高至 50%。
1214.sourceDescription: Your spinning abilities deal 30% increased damage and have their cooldown reduced equivalent to 30 ability haste. The damage amplifier is increased to 50% for ultimate abilities.

2104.name: Spirit Bomb
2104.description:
你对自己或友军施加的治疗和护盾会在头顶积蓄元气弹。累计治疗与护盾总量达到 200 – 2000（基于等级）后，将元气弹抛向受伤最重的友方英雄，飞行 1.1 秒。命中后在 475 半径内爆炸，为范围内友方英雄回复相当于其已损失生命值 5% – 15%（基于等级）（每 100 法术强度 + 3%）的生命值，并提供持续 2 秒的护盾，可吸收相当于其当前生命值 10% – 25%（基于等级）（每 100 法术强度 + 2%）的伤害。

此效果产生的治疗和护盾不计入元气弹的触发条件。
2104.sourceDescription:
Your healing and shielding on yourself or allies builds up a Spirit Bomb on top of you. Once you have healed and shielded a combined total of 200 – 2000 (based on level), you toss the Spirit Bomb onto the most wounded allied champion over 1.1 seconds. Upon impact, the Spirit Bomb explodes in a 475 radius to heal allied champions within the area for 5% – 15% (based on level) (+ 3% per 100 AP) of their missing health and grants them a shield for 2 seconds that absorbs damage equal to 10% – 25% (based on level) (+ 2% per 100 AP) of their current health.

Healing and shielding from this effect do not count toward the Spirit Bomb's trigger condition.

1345.name: Spiritual Purification
1345.description: 参与击杀英雄时，在被击杀英雄周围 500 半径引发爆炸，对范围内敌人造成相当于其当前生命值 15% 的自适应伤害，并留下持续 1.5 秒的区域，使其中敌人减速 60%。
1345.sourceDescription: Scoring a champion takedown causes the area around the slain champion to explode in a 500 unit radius, dealing adaptive damage to enemies within equal to 15% of their current health and leaving behind a zone for 1.5 seconds that slows enemies within by 60%.

1204.name: Stackosaurus Rex
1204.description: 通过技能获得的永久层数增加 100%。
1204.sourceDescription: Increase the number of permanent stacks you gain from abilities by 100%.

1404.name: Stats!
1404.description: 获得 2 个属性锻造器。

1403.name: Stats on Stats!
1403.description: 获得 3 个属性锻造器，且获得黄金和棱彩品质锻造器的几率更高。
1403.sourceDescription: Gain 3 Stat Anvils, with a higher chance of obtaining Gold- and Prismatic-tier anvils.

1402.name: Stats on Stats on Stats!
1402.description: 获得 4 个属性锻造器，且获得黄金和棱彩品质锻造器的几率更高。此外，在下一轮符文选择时，每个符文选项额外获得一次重随机会。
1402.sourceDescription: Gain 4 Stat Anvils, with a higher chance of obtaining Gold- and Prismatic-tier anvils. Additionally, on the next round of augment selection, you gain an additional reroll per augment slot.

1413.name: Stuck in Here With Me
1413.description:
施放终极技能后获得持续 2 秒的光环，期间逐渐扩大，最远达到 500 距离。持续时间结束后，嘲讽光环内所有敌人 2 秒，并在相同时间内获得 50% 伤害减免（冷却时间 30 秒）。此外，获得 30 终极技能急速。

光环在终极技能效果开始生效或结束后激活。
1413.sourceDescription:
Casting your ultimate ability grants you an aura for 2 seconds, growing in size over the duration to up to 500 units. After the duration, you taunt all enemies within the aura for 2 seconds and gain 50% damage reduction for the same duration (30 second cooldown). Additionally, gain 30 ultimate haste.

Aura is activated once the ultimate's effect starts or has elapsed.

2073.name: Siphon
2073.description: 升级你的一个英雄技能，使其回复相当于该技能对敌方英雄造成的减伤后伤害 30% 的生命值。
2073.sourceDescription: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities, empowering the ability to heal you for 30% of its post-mitigation damage dealt to enemy champions.

1079.name: Symphony of War
1079.description: 获得征服者和致命节奏基石符文。
1079.sourceDescription: Gain the Conqueror and Lethal Tempo keystone runes.

1353.name: Tank Engine
1353.description: 参与击杀英雄时获得一层效果，可无限叠加。每层使最大生命值和体型提高 5%。死亡时失去 65% 层数。
1353.sourceDescription: Scoring a champion takedown generates a stack, stacking infinitely. For each stack, increase your maximum health and size by 5%. Lose 65% of stacks on death.

1080.name: Tank It Or Leave It
1080.description:
获得相当于暴击几率 100% 的暴击防御几率，上限为 50%。此外，获得 25% 暴击几率。

暴击防御几率：有一定几率使一次受到的伤害降低 20%（对每次敌方技能施法有 5 秒冷却时间）。
1080.sourceDescription:
Gain Critical Defend Chance equal to 100% critical strike chance, up to 50%. Additionally, gain 25% critical strike chance.

Critical Defend Chance: Grants you a chance to reduce an instance of damage taken by 20% (5 second cooldown per enemy spell cast instance).

1081.name: Tap Dancer
1081.description: 普通攻击的攻击特效命中敌方英雄或小兵时，获得 10 额外移动速度，持续 5 秒，后续触发刷新持续时间，可无限叠加。此外，获得相当于总移动速度 10% 的额外攻击速度。
1081.sourceDescription: Basic attacks on-hit against enemy champions and minions grant 10 bonus movement speed, lasting for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent triggers, and stacking infinitely. Additionally, gain bonus attack speed equal to 10% total movement speed.

2065.name: Terror
2065.description: 升级你的一个英雄技能，使施放该技能时恐惧你周围 450 距离内的所有敌人，持续 1.75 秒（冷却时间 30 秒）。
2065.sourceDescription: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities, empowering the ability's cast to fear all enemies within 450 units of you for 1.75 seconds (30 second cooldown).

1084.name: Thread the Needle
1084.description: 获得 18% 护甲穿透和法术穿透。
1084.sourceDescription: Grants 18% armor penetration and magic penetration.

1243.name: Transmute: Chaos
1243.description: 获得两个完全随机的符文，不包含本轮提供的另外两个符文选项。
1243.sourceDescription: Gain two completely random augments, excluding the other two offerings in your current assortment.

1237.name: Transmute: Gold
1237.description: 获得一个随机黄金符文。

1238.name: Transmute: Prismatic
1238.description: 获得一个随机棱彩符文。

1087.name: Typhoon
1087.description: 普通攻击向附近一名敌人发射飞弹，优先选择英雄，造成 30% 攻击力的物理伤害，并施加攻击特效。
1087.sourceDescription: Basic attacks launch a missile at a nearby enemy, prioritizing champions, that deals 30% AD physical damage and applies on-hit effects.

1088.name: Ultimate Revolution
1088.description: 施放终极技能后，在其效果开始生效或结束时重置其冷却时间（冷却时间 75 秒，死亡时重置）。
1088.sourceDescription: Casting your ultimate ability resets its cooldown once its effect starts or has elapsed (75 second cooldown, reset upon death).

1112.name: Ultimate Unstoppable
1112.description: 施放终极技能后获得 3 秒控制免疫（冷却时间 8 秒）。
1112.sourceDescription: Casting your ultimate ability grants you crowd control immunity for 3 seconds (8 second cooldown).

1320.name: Upgrade Collector
1320.description: 升级收集者：每次击杀敌方英雄，使“死”被动的处决阈值提高 0.5%，上限为目标最大生命值的 12.5%；“税”被动击杀收益额外增加 25 金币（总计 50 金币）。此外，获得 250 金币。
1320.sourceDescription: Upgrades The Collector, empowering Death to have its execution threshold increased by 0.5% each time you kill an enemy champion, capped at a threshold of 12.5% of the target's maximum health, and Taxes to generate a further gold 25 (total gold 50) from kills. Additionally, gain gold 250.

1336.name: Upgrade Infinity Edge
1336.description:
升级无尽之刃，使其获得神圣之剑的剥蚀效果。此外，获得 500 金币。

剥蚀：获得随机数值的额外暴击伤害，最高相当于暴击几率的 50%，该数值每 0.25 秒变化一次。
1336.sourceDescription:
Upgrades Infinity Edge, empowering it to gain Sword of the Divine's Excoriate. Additionally, gain gold 500.

Excoriate: Gain a random amount of bonus critical strike damage that scales up to 50% of your critical strike chance, with the value of this amount changing every 0.25 seconds.

1319.name: Upgrade Immolate
1319.description: 升级斑比的熔渣、璀璨回响、日炎圣盾和虚空献祭：献祭效果每对一名敌方英雄造成一次伤害，额外提供 12 金币。此外，获得 250 金币。
1319.sourceDescription: Upgrades Bami's Cinder, Hollow Radiance, Sunfire Aegis, and Void Immolation, empowering Immolate to additionally grant you gold 12 per tick for each enemy champion afflicted by its effect. Additionally, gain gold 250.

1996.name: Upgrade Sheen
1996.description: 升级所有具有咒刃效果的装备，使该被动额外造成相当于目标最大生命值 4% 的物理伤害，并为你回复相当于目标最大生命值 3.5% 的生命值。此外，获得 250 金币。
1996.sourceDescription: Upgrades all Spellblade items, empowering the passive effect to deal additional bonus physical damage equal to 4% of the target's maximum health and heal you for 3.5% of the target's maximum health. Additionally, gain gold 250.

1318.name: Upgrade Zhonya's
1318.description: 升级探索者的护臂、沃格勒特的巫师帽和中娅沙漏：凝滞会净化你身上的所有控制效果，并允许你在生效期间移动，期间还获得 50% 额外移动速度。此外，中娅沙漏的凝滞冷却时间降至 45 秒。
1318.sourceDescription: Upgrades Seeker's Armguard, Wooglet's Witchcap, and Zhonya's Hourglass, empowering Stasis to cleanse you of all crowd control and allow you to move during its active effect, during which time you also gain 50% bonus movement speed. Additionally, the cooldown of Zhonya's Hourglass' Stasis is reduced to 45 seconds.

1092.name: Vulnerability
1092.description:
装备伤害和持续伤害现在可以暴击，造成（145% + 额外暴击伤害）伤害（每次施法有 5 秒冷却时间）。此外，获得 25% 暴击几率。

若同时拥有珠光护手和易损，只使用暴击伤害更高的那个符文来判定暴击；若相同，则使用其中任意一个。
1092.sourceDescription:
Damage dealt by items and damage over time effects can now critically strike for (145% + bonus critical damage) damage (5 second cooldown per cast instance). Additionally, gain 25% critical strike chance.

If both Jeweled Gauntlet and Vulnerability are equipped, only rolls the critical strike chance of the augment that has the higher critical damage (or either if equal).

1005.name: Wee Woo Wee Woo
1005.description: 朝附近友方英雄移动时，获得 0% – 50%（基于目标友军已损失生命值）额外移动速度；不再朝向友军后，加成仍持续 2 秒。你的治疗和护盾效果也提高 0% – 50%（基于目标已损失生命值）。
1005.sourceDescription: Gain 0% – 50% (based on target ally's missing health) bonus movement speed while facing toward nearby allied champions, lingering for 2 seconds after no longer facing them. Your heals and shields are also increased by 0% – 50% (based on target's missing health).

1095.name: Windspeaker's Blessing
1095.description: 你或友军对你施加治疗和护盾，或者你对友军施加治疗和护盾时，会使目标获得 30 – 60（基于等级）额外护甲和额外魔法抗性，持续 3 秒。
1095.sourceDescription: Your or allies' heals and shields on yourself, or your heals and shields on allies, grant the target 30 – 60 (based on level) bonus armor and bonus magic resistance for 3 seconds.

1097.name: Witchful Thinking
1097.description: 获得 20 – 80（基于等级）法术强度。

1098.name: With Haste
1098.description: 获得相当于技能急速 70% 的额外移动速度。
1098.sourceDescription: Grants bonus movement speed equal to 70% ability haste.

2089.name: Yowch, My Coins!
2089.description: 你参与击杀的敌方英雄会掉落 6 – 10（基于等级）枚金币，每枚落在距死亡位置 500 距离处，持续 10 秒。你或友方英雄走过即可拾取，每枚提供 15 金币。
2089.sourceDescription: Enemy champions that you score a takedown against drop 6 – 10 (based on level) coins, with each coin landing 500 units away from the location of their death and lasting 10 seconds. You or allied champions can collect the coins by moving over them, granting gold 15 for each coin collected.

2009.name: Zealot
2009.description: 获得 35%（每 100 法术强度 + 5%）额外攻击速度和 25%（每 100 法术强度 + 5%）暴击几率。
2009.sourceDescription: Gain 35% (+ 5% per 100 AP) bonus attack speed and 25% (+ 5% per 100 AP) critical strike chance.

1206.name: EscAPADe
1206.description: 将所有法术强度转化为额外攻击力，每 1.66 法术强度转化为 1 额外攻击力。此外，总攻击力提高 15%。
1206.sourceDescription: Convert all of your ability power into bonus attack damage at a rate of 1 bonus attack damage per 1.66 ability power. Additionally, increase your total attack damage by 15%.

2062.name: Echo Cast
2062.description: 升级你的一个英雄技能，施放时召唤一个不可被选取的分身，朝鼠标位置移动最多 500 距离。分身在 0.25 秒延迟后施放召唤它的技能，模仿该技能的主动效果，并在施放结束后消失。
2062.sourceDescription: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities, empowering the ability's cast to summon a clone of your champion that is untargetable and moves up to 500 units towards your cursor. The clone then casts the ability it was summoned from after a 0.25-second delay, mimicking the active effects of the casted spell and disappearing after it finishes casting.

1327.name: Adamant
1327.description:
定身或缚地敌方英雄时，获得 10 额外护甲和额外魔法抗性，持续 10 秒，最多叠加 10 层，共提供 100 额外双抗。后续触发刷新持续时间（每次施法有 5 秒冷却时间）。

原文注明：此符文目前已禁用。
1327.sourceDescription:
Immobilizing or grounding an enemy champion grants 10 bonus armor and bonus magic resistance for 10 seconds, stacking up to 10 times for a total of 100 bonus resistances, and refreshing on subsequent triggers (5 second cooldown per cast instance).

This augment is currently disabled.

1329.name: Biggest Snowball Ever
1329.description:
将标记（雪球）升级为巨型雪球，扩大其半径，并使其能够穿过非英雄单位。雪球击中目标时还会爆炸，对附近所有敌人造成 200 – 350（基于等级）（+ 100% 额外攻击力）（+ 60% 法术强度）魔法伤害，将其击飞 0.75 秒，并减速 20%，持续 2 秒。此外，标记获得相当于 100 技能急速的冷却缩减。

若未携带标记，会提示你将一个召唤师技能替换为标记。雪球命中的非英雄单位会被晕眩 1.25 秒。
1329.sourceDescription:
Upgrades your Mark into a massive snowball, empowering it with an increased size radius and the ability to pass through non-champions. The snowball additionally explodes upon impact of the target hit to deal 200 – 350 (based on level) (+ 100% bonus AD) (+ 60% AP) magic damage to all nearby enemies, knock them up for 0.75 seconds, and slow them by 20% for 2 seconds. Additionally, your Mark's cooldown is reduced equivalent to 100 ability haste.

If Mark is not equipped, you will be prompted to replace one of your summoner spells with Mark. Non-champions hit by the snowball are stunned for 1.25 seconds.

2128.name: Combusting Interest
2128.description: 每次以持续伤害对敌方英雄造成伤害时，获得 1 – 3（基于等级）（+ 所造成伤害的 0.75%）金币。
2128.sourceDescription: Gain gold 1 – 3 (based on level) (+ 0.75% of damage dealt) gold for each tick of damage dealt to enemy champions with damage over time effects.

2111.name: BONK!
2111.description: 升级你的一个具有强化普通攻击效果的技能，使该强化攻击对目标造成的伤害提高 30%，并对附近敌人造成相当于该攻击伤害 30% 的伤害。
2111.sourceDescription: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities that has an empowered basic attack effect, further enhancing the attack to deal 30% increased damage to the target and 30% of its damage to nearby enemies.

2042.name: Hide on Bush
2042.description: 在草丛中时，造成的伤害提高 20%。离开草丛后，此效果仍持续 2 秒。
2042.sourceDescription: While in brush, you deal 20% increased damage. This effect lingers for 2 seconds after leaving brush.

2083.name: Tooth Fairy
2083.description: 在 2.5 秒内对敌方英雄造成至少相当于其最大生命值 25% 的伤害时，该英雄会在地面掉落一颗牙齿（每个目标的冷却时间为 4 秒）。走过牙齿即可拾取，获得一层牙科记录。每层提供 3 穿甲和固定法术穿透。
2083.sourceDescription: When you deal damage to an enemy champion equal to or more than 25% of their maximum health within 2.5 seconds, they drop a Tooth on the ground (4 second cooldown per target). You can pick up this Tooth by moving over it, granting you a Dental Records stack. For each stack, you gain 3 lethality and flat magic penetration.

2078.name: Chain Reaction
2078.description:
升级你的一个带有击退效果的技能：被位移的英雄在 200 距离内撞到其他英雄或地形时触发连锁反应。若被击退的英雄在位移期间撞到另一名敌方英雄，被撞到的英雄受到 100 – 400（基于等级）魔法伤害，并被击飞 0.5 秒。若在位移期间撞到地形，被击退的英雄会弹回，受到 150 – 800（基于等级）魔法伤害，被击飞 0.75 秒并晕眩 0.5 秒。击飞时间随技能冷却时间增加，最高为 1.1 秒。

若升级的技能是终极技能，此效果造成 250% 伤害：英雄碰撞伤害提高至 250 – 1000（基于等级），地形碰撞伤害提高至 375 – 2000（基于等级）。
2078.sourceDescription:
Upgrades one of your champion's abilities that has a knock back effect, empowering the ability to trigger a chain reaction effect when displaced champions hit other champions or terrain within 200 units. If a knocked back champion collides with another enemy champion during their displacement, the champions they collided with are dealt 100 – 400 (based on level) magic damage and knocked up for 0.5 seconds. If they collide with terrain during their displacement, they will rebound to take 150 – 800 (based on level) magic damage and become knocked up for 0.75 seconds and stunned for 0.5 seconds. The knock up duration is increased to up to 1.1 seconds based on how long the ability's cooldown is.

If the upgraded ability is an ultimate, this effect deals 250% damage, increasing the champion collision damage to 250 – 1000 (based on level) and the terrain collision damage to 375 – 2000 (based on level).

2024.name: Crit 'n Cast
2024.description: 获得相当于暴击几率 40% 的技能急速。
2024.sourceDescription: Gain ability haste equal to 40% of your critical strike chance.

1356.name: Critical Missile
1356.description: 对敌方英雄的暴击会向目标发射 1（每 50% 暴击几率 + 1）枚飞弹，每枚造成 15 – 65（基于等级）魔法伤害。此外，获得 25% 暴击几率。
1356.sourceDescription: Critical strikes against enemy champions launch 1 (+ 1 per 50% critical strike chance) missiles at the target that each deal 15 – 65 (based on level) magic damage. Additionally, gain 25% critical strike chance.

1328.name: Critical Rhythm
1328.description: 你的暴击提供 6% 额外攻击速度，持续 6 秒，最多叠加 10 层，共提供 60%。此外，获得 25% 暴击几率。
1328.sourceDescription: Your critical strikes grant you 6% bonus attack speed for 6 seconds, stacking up to 10 times for a total of 60%. Additionally, gain 25% critical strike chance.

2077.name: Ravenous Bind
2077.description: 升级你的一个带有定身或缚地效果的技能，使其对受影响目标造成 15 – 90（基于等级）（+ 10% 法术强度）（+ 0.5% 你的最大生命值）魔法伤害，并为你回复 50 – 200（基于等级）（+ 5% 法术强度）（+ 10% 额外生命值）生命值。技能冷却时间越长，治疗量越高，最多提高 50%。
2077.sourceDescription: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities that has a immobilizing or grounding effect, empowering the ability to deal 15 – 90 (based on level) (+ 10% AP) (+ 0.5% of your maximum health) magic damage to affected targets and heal you for 50 – 200 (based on level) (+ 5% AP) (+ 10% bonus health). The heal is increased by up to 50% based on how long the ability's cooldown is.

2063.name: Dimension Shift
2063.description:
将一个召唤师技能替换为当黑暗到来。

当黑暗到来：向目标位置投出一道明亮的宇宙光芒，沿弧线飞行 2 秒。命中后光芒扩散，将 500 半径内所有单位送入黑暗位面，持续 8 秒。黑暗位面内所有单位获得 45% 额外移动速度。若你在黑暗位面内，获得 35 – 150（基于等级）额外攻击力、35 – 150（基于等级）法术强度、300 – 1500（基于等级）额外生命值，并使体型增大 35%。

黑暗位面是位于正常世界之外的另一个维度的战场，仅对被宇宙光芒命中的单位存在。它包含正常世界地图中的地形，包括建筑、墙壁和草丛。

不同位面的单位互相看见的是发光星点，彼此视为死亡，无法互相交互。只有被光芒命中的单位会进入该位面，其他单位无法跟随进入。黑暗位面中发生的一切对外部单位不可见，反之亦然。

建筑同时存在于所有位面，但黑暗位面中的英雄每次伤害只能对建筑造成 1 点伤害。防御塔仍正常运作，如同所有单位都在同一位面。黑暗位面结束时，仍在其中的召唤物会被杀死。
2063.sourceDescription:
Replace a summoner spell with When the Darkness Comes.

When the Darkness Comes: Sends a bright, cosmic light arcing to the target location over 2 seconds. Upon impact, the light spreads out to cause all units within a 500 radius to be sent to the Dark Realm for 8 seconds. All units in the Dark Realm gain 45% bonus movement speed. If you are in the Dark Realm, you gain 35 – 150 (based on level) bonus attack damage, 35 – 150 (based on level) ability power, 300 – 1500 (based on level) bonus health, and 35% increased size.

The Dark Realm is a battlefield that exists outside of the normal realm in an alternate dimension. It exists only for units hit by the cosmic light. The realm includes any terrain features that would exist in the map of the normal realm, including structures, walls, and brushes.

Units between realms see each other as glowing stars, considering each other dead and negating any interactions between each other. Only units that were hit by the light will enter the realm; other units cannot follow them. Everything that occurs inside the Dark Realm is hidden to units outside of it, and vice versa.

Structures exist in all realms at the same time, but champions in the Dark Realm can only deal 1 damage to them per damage instance. Turrets will behave normally as if all units were in the same realm. Pets still inside the Dark Realm are killed at its end.

1384.name: Donation
1384.description: 获得此符文时获得 1750 金币。
1384.sourceDescription: Gain gold 1750 upon acquiring this augment.

2131.name: Don't Change the Channel
2131.description: 每引导技能一秒，就获得可吸收 50 – 200（基于等级）（+ 50% 攻击力）（+ 25% 法术强度）（+ 10% 额外生命值）伤害的护盾。停止引导后，护盾快速衰减。
2131.sourceDescription: For every second that you channel an ability, you gain a 50 – 200 (based on level) (+ 50% AD) (+ 25% AP) (+ 10% bonus health) shield. The shield quickly decays once you stop channeling.

2144.name: Bolstered
2144.description: 升级你的一个带有护盾效果的技能，使其护盾强度提高 0% – 60%（基于目标已损失生命值）。
2144.sourceDescription: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities that has a shield effect, increasing the strength of the ability's shield by 0% – 60% (based on target's missing health).

2148.name: Double Strike
2148.description:
升级你的一个具有强化普通攻击效果的技能，使强化攻击对命中目标额外施加一次攻击特效。

原文注明：此符文存在于内部符文数据中，但似乎已被禁用。
2148.sourceDescription:
Upgrades one of your champion's abilities that has an empowered basic attack effect, further enhancing the attack to apply on-hit effects to targets it hits a second time.

This augment exists in the internal augment data but appears to be disabled.

1331.name: Empyrean Promise
1331.description:
将一个召唤师技能替换为天界之诺的主动技能“警戒”。此外，获得 15% 治疗和护盾强度。

主动——警戒：延迟 0.25 秒后，冲刺至目标友方英雄的当前位置，并获得持续 3 秒的护盾，可吸收 100 – 250（基于等级）（+ 100% 法术强度）（+ 10% 额外生命值）伤害。抵达后，为该友军提供相同护盾（冷却时间 20 秒；施法距离 2000）。
1331.sourceDescription:
Replace a summoner spell with Empyrean Promise's Vigilance active. Additionally, gain 15% heal and shield power.

Active - Vigilance: After a 0.25-second delay, dash to the current location of the target allied champion and gain a 100 – 250 (based on level) (+ 100% AP) (+ 10% bonus health) shield for 3 seconds. Upon arrival, grant the ally the same shield (20 second cooldown; 2000 range).

2091.name: Endless Decimation
2091.description: 战斗中自动施放强化版德莱厄斯大杀四方，蓄力 1.25 秒后横扫周围 460 半径。对范围内敌人造成 100 – 400（基于等级）（+ 60% 攻击力）（+ 40% 法术强度）物理伤害（冷却时间 8 秒）。240 内圈半径中的敌人只受到 50% 伤害。此外，每命中一名外圈敌方英雄，为你回复已损失生命值的 18%，并使此效果冷却时间缩短 10%，最低为 3 秒。
2091.sourceDescription: While in combat, automatically cast an improved version of Darius' Decimate, winding up over 1.25 seconds to slash in a 460 radius around you. The slash deals 100 – 400 (based on level) (+ 60% AD) (+ 40% AP) physical damage to enemies within the area (8 second cooldown). Enemies within the 240 inner radius of the slash take「 50% damage. 」Additionally, for each enemy champion hit along the outer edge, you heal for 18% of your missing health and the cooldown of this effect is reduced by 10%, down to a minimum of 3 seconds.

2082.name: Our Healing
2082.description: 附近单位受到治疗时（你自己除外），为你回复相当于其治疗量 15% 的生命值；来自敌人的治疗量则翻倍，为 30%。
2082.sourceDescription: Whenever a nearby unit is healed (excluding yourself), you heal yourself equal to 15% of the amount they healed, doubled to 30% from the heals of enemies.

1333.name: Escape Plan
1333.description: 生命值降至最大生命值的 35% 以下时，获得相当于最大生命值 65% 的护盾、150% 额外移动速度，并缩小体型（冷却时间 75 秒）。上述效果都在 5.5 秒内衰减。
1333.sourceDescription: Upon dropping below 35% of your maximum health, gain a shield for 65% of your maximum health, 150% bonus movement speed, and reduced size (75 second cooldown). These effects all decay over 5.5 seconds.

1344.name: Final Form
1344.description: 施放终极技能后强化自身 10 秒，期间获得相当于最大生命值 50% 的护盾、20% 全能吸血和 30% 额外移动速度（冷却时间 20 秒）。
1344.sourceDescription: Casting your ultimate ability empowers you for 10 seconds, causing you to gain a shield for 50% of your maximum health, 20% omnivamp, and 30% bonus movement speed for the duration (20 second cooldown).

2032.name: Shark Bait
2032.description:
受到致命伤害时，变成鲨鱼诱饵，进入持续 3.5 秒的僵尸状态。期间移动速度固定为 400，可以无视单位碰撞，并使周围 400 距离内敌人减速 40%。持续时间结束后，巨型鲨鱼从下方跃出，在 400 半径内猛烈撕咬，对范围内所有敌人造成 120 – 350（基于等级）（+ 30% 目标已损失生命值）魔法伤害，并击飞 1 秒。

僵尸状态下，你可以移动，并处于无敌、不可被选取和控制免疫状态，但无法发动普通攻击、施放技能、使用召唤师技能或主动装备。
2032.sourceDescription:
Upon taking fatal damage, you become a Shark Bait, causing you to enter a zombie state for 3.5 seconds, during which your movement speed is set to a static 400, you gain ghosting, and enemies within 400 units of you are slowed by 40%. At the end of the duration, a massive shark emerges from beneath you that lets out a powerful chomp (400 radius), dealing 120 – 350 (based on level) (+ 30% of target's missing health) magic damage to all enemies within the area and knocking them up for 1 second.

While under the zombie state, you are able to move and become invulnerable, untargetable, and immune to crowd control, but you are also rendered unable to declare basic attacks, cast abilities, use summoner spells, and activate items.

1348.name: Flash 2
1348.description: 将一个召唤师技能替换为闪现。此外，获得 70 召唤师技能急速。
1348.sourceDescription: Replace a summoner spell with Flash. Additionally, gain 70 summoner spell haste.

2127.name: Forged By The Master
2127.description: 你的装备效果和符文造成的伤害提高 45%。
2127.sourceDescription: Increases the damage dealt by your item effects and augments by 45%.

1325.name: Glass Cannon
1325.description: 你的生命值上限阈值变为最大生命值的 70%，且无法以任何方式修改或超过该阈值。作为交换，你会额外造成相当于所有减伤前伤害近战 25% / 远程 15% 的真实伤害。
1325.sourceDescription: You gain a health threshold equal to 70% maximum health which cannot be modified nor exceeded by any means. In return, you deal bonus true damage equal to (melee 25% / ranged 15%) of all of the damage you deal pre-mitigation.

1392.name: Holy Snowball
1392.description:
使用标记（雪球）的突进技能后，抵达目标时获得 1.5 秒无敌。此外，标记获得相当于 100 技能急速的冷却缩减。

若未携带标记，会提示你将一个召唤师技能替换为标记。
1392.sourceDescription:
After using the Dash spell from Mark, you become invulnerable for 1.5 seconds upon arrival. Additionally, your Mark's cooldown is reduced equivalent to 100 ability haste.

If Mark is not equipped, you will be prompted to replace one of your summoner spells with Mark.

1335.name: Goldrend
1335.description: 普通攻击或技能对敌方英雄造成伤害时，额外造成 50 – 150（基于等级）（+ 40% 额外攻击力）（+ 20% 法术强度）魔法伤害，并提供 30 金币和持续 1.5 秒的 25% 额外移动速度（每名英雄的冷却时间为 30 秒）。
1335.sourceDescription: Damaging basic attacks or abilities against enemy champions deal 50 – 150 (based on level) (+ 40% bonus AD) (+ 20% AP) bonus magic damage, and grant you gold 30 and 25% bonus movement speed for 1.5 seconds (30 second cooldown per champion).

1401.name: Growth Spurt
1401.description:
将一个召唤师技能替换为成长突增。

成长突增：使自身变大，将 400 距离内敌人击飞 1 秒。在接下来的 7 秒内，获得 300（+ 20% 最大生命值）额外生命值，体型增大 50%。
1401.sourceDescription:
Replace a summoner spell with Growth Spurt.

Growth Spurt: Enlarge yourself, causing you to knock up enemies within 400 units for 1 second. For the next 7 seconds, you gain 300 (+ 20% maximum health) bonus health and 50% increased size.

1389.name: Hand of Baron
1389.description: 获得改版的男爵之手，仅提供自适应之力提高 25%，并大幅强化附近友方小兵。
1389.sourceDescription: Gain a modified Hand of Baron, which only grants 25% increased adaptive force and greatly empowers nearby allied minions.

1416.name: Hextech Soul
1416.description: 获得海克斯科技龙魂；若已拥有，则获得另一种龙魂。
1416.sourceDescription: Grants the Hextech Dragon Soul, or a different Dragon Soul if you aleady have it.

1388.name: Infinite Recursion
1388.description: 获得 60 技能急速，每次参与击杀英雄额外增加 3。
1388.sourceDescription: Gain 60 ability haste, increased by 3 each time you score a champion takedown.

2125.name: It's Go Time
2125.description: 升级你的一个具有持续性效果的技能，使其在效果持续期间提供 25% – 45%（基于等级）额外移动速度。
2125.sourceDescription: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities that has a duration-based effect, empowering the ability to grant 25% – 45% (based on level) bonus movement speed for the effect's duration.

2126.name: Reload
2126.description:
升级你的一个具有持续性效果的技能，使效果持续期间的普通攻击特效将该技能剩余冷却时间减少 0.15 – 0.35（基于等级）秒。

原文注明：此符文存在于内部符文数据中，但似乎已被禁用。
2126.sourceDescription:
Upgrades one of your champion's abilities that has a duration-based effect, causing basic attacks on-hit during the ability to reduce its remaining cooldown by 0.15 – 0.35 (based on level) seconds.

This augment exists in the internal augment data but appears to be disabled.

2026.name: Kill Secured
2026.description: 朝生命值低于最大生命值 40% 的敌方英雄移动时，获得 60% 额外移动速度。
2026.sourceDescription: Gain 60% bonus movement speed towards enemy champions below 40% of their maximum health.

1337.name: King Me
1337.description:
首次进入敌方出生点附近的传送门或弹射器时，你将加冕，获得一个随机棱彩符文，并升级装备栏中第一件符合条件的传说装备，提高其属性。该装备所有可升级属性的金币价值合计恰好提高 1000 金币。

此符文按装备栏位置逐格检查，优先升级找到的第一件符合条件的传说装备。
1337.sourceDescription:
Upon entering the enemy team's gate or Catapult for the first time, either of which are located near their spawn, you become Kinged, causing you to gain one random Prismatic-tier augment and the first eligible Legendary item in your inventory to be upgraded with improved stats. The gold value of all upgradeable stats on the item is increased by exactly gold 1000.

King Me prioritize upgrading the first Legendary item eligible for a upgrade based on its position in the inventory, detecting each slot until an eligible item is found.

2096.name: Lil' Extra Help
2096.description: 升级你的一个能在一段时间内强化普通攻击的技能，使效果持续期间额外获得攻击距离（近战 150 / 远程 100）和额外攻击速度（近战 75% / 远程 40%）。
2096.sourceDescription: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities that has an effect which empowers your basic attacks for a duration, further enhancing the attacks by granting you (melee 150 / ranged 100) bonus attack range and (melee 75% / ranged 40%) bonus attack speed while the effect is active.

2133.name: Mercy's Strike
2133.description: 升级你的一个英雄技能，使施放该技能后强化下一次普通攻击。强化攻击获得 300 额外攻击距离、75% 额外攻击速度，并额外造成相当于目标最大生命值 3%（每 10% 治疗和护盾强度 + 2%）的魔法伤害。若目标是防御塔，额外魔法伤害改为其最大生命值的 2.5%。
2133.sourceDescription: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities, empowering the ability's cast to enhance your next basic attack. The enhanced attack has 300 bonus range, gains 75% bonus attack speed, and deals bonus magic damage equal to 3% (+ 2% per 10% heal and shield power) of the target's maximum health. If the target is a turret, the damage is modified to 2.5% of the target's maximum health bonus magic damage.

1314.name: Mighty Shield
1314.description: 获得护盾时，获得 40 – 100（基于等级）自适应之力，持续 3 秒（冷却时间 5 秒）。
1314.sourceDescription: Gain 40 – 100 (based on level) adaptive force for 3 seconds upon gaining a shield (5 second cooldown).

2072.name: Spell Split
2072.description:
升级你的一个具有飞弹的技能，使飞弹到达最大距离或再次施放时，在 0.25 秒内一分为二。分裂飞弹沿垂直于原方向的两个相反方向发射，对命中敌人施加相同效果。同次施法的后续飞弹对同一敌人只造成 30% 伤害。

初次施放 0.15 秒后可再次施放。
2072.sourceDescription:
Upgrades one of your champion's abilities that has a missile, empowering the ability's missile to split in two over 0.25 seconds upon reaching maximum range, or when recast. Each of the split missiles fire perpendicularly in opposite directions and apply the same effects to enemies they hit. Subsequent missile hits from the same cast against the same enemy deal 30% damage.

Recast can be used after 0.15 seconds of the initial cast.

2043.name: Nature is Healing
2043.description: 进入一片草丛时，在 1.5 秒内回复 40 – 300（基于等级）（+ 15% 已损失生命值）生命值（每片草丛的冷却时间为 20 秒）。
2043.sourceDescription: Upon entering a patch of brush, you are healed for「 40 – 300 (based on level) (+ 15% of your missing health) 」over 1.5 seconds (20 second cooldown per brush patch).

1326.name: Nightstalking
1326.description: 对敌方英雄造成伤害后的 3 秒内参与击杀，会使你隐形 1.5 秒，期间还获得 40% 额外移动速度。攻击或施放技能会立即结束隐形。
1326.sourceDescription: Scoring a takedown against an enemy champion within 3 seconds of damaging them renders you invisible for 1.5 seconds, during which you also gain 40% bonus movement speed. Attacking or casting abilites ends the stealth immediately.

1332.name: Ominous Pact
1332.description: 你的技能现在每次施放需要消耗当前生命值的 5%。作为交换，根据已损失生命值获得法术强度，在损失 70% 生命值时达到最高 75 – 150（基于等级）；还获得 0% – 50%（基于已损失生命值）额外移动速度和 0% – 20%（基于已损失生命值）全能吸血。
1332.sourceDescription: Your abilities now have a health cost of 5% current health to cast them. In return, you gain ability power based on your missing health, up to 75 – 150 (based on level) at 70% missing health, 0% – 50% (based on missing health) bonus movement speed, and 0% – 20% (based on missing health) omnivamp.

2119.name: Overextender
2119.description:
强化你使用大炮发射器的发射效果：发射距离增加 12,000，落地伤害提高 50%，飞行速度也大幅提高。此外，你现在可以回城，且回城升级为强化回城。

此符文仅在屠夫之桥地图提供。

总发射距离为 18,500；己方外侧防御塔被摧毁后降至 16,500。强化后的落地伤害为 180 – 690（基于等级）魔法伤害。
2119.sourceDescription:
Your launch with the Cannon Launcher is now empowered, increasing the launch range by 12,000 units and the impact damage by 50%, as well as the travel speed by a significant amount. Additionally, your Recall is now functional and is upgraded to Empowered Recall.

This augment is only available on the Butcher's Bridge map.

Total launch range is 18,500 units, reduced to 16,500 after your team's Outer turret is destroyed. Increased impact damage is 180 – 690 (based on level) magic damage.

2135.name: Pin Cushion
2135.description: 升级你的一个具有持续性效果的技能，使效果期间的普通攻击对敌方英雄施加钉刺层数。技能持续时间结束或你死亡时，消耗所有目标身上的层数，每层对其造成 20 – 60（基于等级）物理伤害。若该效果足以造成致命伤害，则立即消耗层数。此外，每当消耗一个目标的层数时，每消耗一层就提供 10 额外移动速度，持续 3 秒。
2135.sourceDescription: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities that has a duration-based effect, empowering it to cause basic attacks during the ability's effect to apply Nail stacks against enemy champions. At the end of the ability's duration, or if you die, the stacks on all targets are consumed, dealing 20 – 60 (based on level) physical damage per Nail stack on the target. If this effect would deal lethal damage to the target, the stacks are consumed immediately. Additionally, once a target's stacks are consumed, you gain 10 bonus movement speed per consumed stack for 3 seconds.

2123.name: Overloaded
2123.description: 升级你的一个英雄技能，使你每次施放其他技能时都重置该技能的冷却时间。
2123.sourceDescription: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities, empowering the ability to have its cooldown reset whenever you cast a different ability.

2137.name: Pat On The Back
2137.description: 当你与友方英雄相距不超过 200 距离时，对方会拍拍你的背，提供可吸收 50 – 150（基于等级）（+ 25% 额外移动速度）伤害的护盾，以及 30% 额外移动速度，持续 3 秒（冷却时间 9 秒）。后续经过只会刷新效果持续时间。
2137.sourceDescription: Whenever you are within 200 units of an allied champion, they pat you on the back, granting you a 50 – 150 (based on level) (+ 25% bonus movement speed) shield and 30% bonus movement speed for 3 seconds (9 second cooldown). Subsequent passes only refresh the duration of the effects.

2139.name: Porcupine
2139.description: 受到敌方英雄伤害时在体内积蓄尖刺，最多储存 400 – 3900（基于等级）减伤前伤害。达到储存上限后，消耗储存伤害，向周围 400 半径迸发尖刺，对命中敌人造成 75 – 200（基于等级）（+ 125% 额外护甲）（+ 125% 额外魔法抗性）物理伤害，并使其减速 30%，持续 2 秒。
2139.sourceDescription: You build up a burst of needles from within you when taking damage from enemy champions, storing up to 400 – 3900 (based on level) pre-mitigation damage taken. After reaching the maximum damage stored, you consume the stored damage to burst the needles outward in a 400 radius, dealing 75 – 200 (based on level) (+ 125% bonus armor) (+ 125% bonus magic resistance) physical damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 30% for 2 seconds.

1358.name: Pinball
1358.description:
标记（雪球）改为投出弹球，额外造成 100 – 500（基于等级）真实伤害，并在碰到地形时弹射。每次弹射都会重置剩余飞行距离，使半径增大 25%、伤害提高 20%，并使标记的剩余冷却时间减少 30%。弹球最多弹射 4 次，半径最高增大 100%、伤害最高提高 80%。此外，标记获得相当于 50 技能急速的冷却缩减。

若未携带标记，会提示你将一个召唤师技能替换为标记。
1358.sourceDescription:
Your Mark is empowered to instead throw a pinball, which deals 100 – 500 (based on level) bonus true damage and ricochets off of terrain that it collides with. Each time the pinball ricochets, its remaining travel distance is reset, it increases in radius by 25%, deals 20% increased damage, and reduces Mark's remaining cooldown by 30%. The pinball can ricochet up to 4 times, for a maximum radius increase of 100% and a damage increase of 80%. Additionally, your Mark's cooldown is reduced equivalent to 50 ability haste.

If Mark is not equipped, you will be prompted to replace one of your summoner spells with Mark.

1347.name: Poltergeist
1347.description:
将一个召唤师技能替换为闹鬼。

闹鬼：对自身同时施放屏障和幽灵疾步，两者均持续 5 秒。屏障提供可吸收 110 – 440（基于等级）伤害的护盾，幽灵疾步提供 30% 额外移动速度。
1347.sourceDescription:
Replace a summoner spell with Poltergeist.

Poltergeist: Casts both Barrier and Ghost on yourself, both lasting 5 seconds and with the former granting a shield for 110 – 440 (based on level) and the latter granting 30% bonus movement speed.

2046.name: Poro Stampede
2046.description:
每 25 – 15（基于等级）秒，你周围会随机出现魄罗佳肴。走过即可拾取，获得一层魄罗佳肴充能。达到充能上限（2 层）时，不会再生成佳肴。用佳肴喂食魄罗会获得一层魄罗之爱。达到 5 层时，获得魄罗冲锋召唤师技能，并提示你替换一个召唤师技能。随后获得任务，要求达到指定的魄罗之爱层数。任务共有九个阶段，每完成一个阶段，魄罗冲锋就额外增加一波魄罗。

魄罗冲锋：延迟 1 秒后召唤一排 5 只巨型魄罗，向目标方向冲锋。命中的敌人受到 100 – 200（基于等级）（每层魄罗之爱 + 20）物理伤害，对小兵的伤害降至 15%，并被减速 85%，持续 2 秒。每只魄罗撞到敌方英雄时停止前进。

根据魄罗之爱层数发射额外的魄罗波次。每一波在上一波之后 0.75 秒发射。敌方英雄受到后续波次命中时，只受到 50% 伤害。
2046.sourceDescription:
Poro-Snaxes will now randomly appear around you every 25 – 15 (based on level) seconds. You can pick up a Poro-Snax by moving over it, granting you a Poro-Snax charge. Poro-Snaxes will not spawn while you are at the maximum number of Poro-Snax charges (2). Feeding a Poro with a Poro-Snax generates a stack of Poro Love. At 5 stacks, you are granted the Poro Charge summoner spell and are prompted to replace one of your summoner spells with it. You are then assigned with quests that require you to reach a certain amount of Poro Love stacks. There are nine quest tiers, and each completed tier rewards you with an additional Poro wave for Poro Charge.

Poro Charge: After a 1-second delay, you unleash a stampede of Poros, summoning a phalanx of 5 massive Poros that charge forward in the target direction. Enemies hit by the charge are dealt 100 – 200 (based on level) (+ 20 per Poro Love stack) physical damage, reduced to 15% against minions, and slowed by 85% for 2 seconds. Each Poro stops upon colliding with an enemy champion.

Fire additional waves of Poros based on the number of Poro Love stacks you have. Each subsequent wave is fired 0.75 seconds after the previous one. Enemy champions take 50% damage from subsequent waves that hit them.

2102.name: Pressure Cooker
2102.description:
火焰环绕你，每秒对周围 300 距离内的敌方英雄施加持续 3 秒的灼烧，每秒造成相当于你最大生命值 0.5% 的魔法伤害。灼烧可无限叠加，每次施加刷新持续时间。

此外，获得任务，要求用此灼烧对敌方英雄造成指定伤害量。任务共有三个阶段，每完成一个阶段，就获得强化此符文效果的奖励。
2102.sourceDescription:
Surrounds you in flames, causing you to apply a Burn every second to enemy champions within 300 units for 3 seconds that deals magic damage equal to「 0.5% of your maximum health per second. 」This Burn stacks infinitely and refreshes with each application.

Additionally, you are assigned with quests that require you to deal a certain amount of damage with the Burn effect against enemy champions. There are three quest tiers, and each completed tier grants you a reward that improves Pressure Cooker's effect.

1421.name: Prom Queen
1421.description:
自动施放改版的洛惊鸿过隙，强化自身并进入持续 6 秒的迷人冲刺。期间可无视单位碰撞，获得 50% 额外移动速度；与你碰撞的敌人会被击落并受到 1.5 秒魅惑（冷却时间 35 秒）。

效果激活前 2.5 秒，一顶闪亮头冠会降落在你身上。
1421.sourceDescription:
Automatically cast a modified version of Rakan's The Quickness, empowering you to break into a captivating sprint for 6 seconds. While empowered, you gain ghosting and 50% bonus movement speed, and enemies you collide with are knocked down and become charmed for 1.5 seconds (35 second cooldown).

A sparkly tiara will descend upon you 2.5 seconds before the effect activates.

1343.name: Quest: Sneakerhead
1343.description:
获得任务，要求穿着指定鞋子完成特定目标；对应任务期间会免费提供该鞋子。以下任务按随机顺序分配：

任务——狂战士胫甲：进行 25 次普通攻击。

任务——轻灵之靴：移动 300 步。

任务——明朗之靴：施放 20 次技能。

任务——水银之靴：受到 5 次控制效果。

任务——铁板靴：通过镀层效果累计减免 200 伤害。

任务——法师之靴：用技能累计造成 1500 伤害。

奖励：完成以上所有任务后，获得嘉文一世之靴。

拥有此符文时无法购买任何鞋类装备。若已拥有鞋子，会被此效果提供的鞋子替换。此效果提供的鞋子无法出售。

原文注明：此符文目前已禁用。
1343.sourceDescription:
Assigns quests that require you to perform specific tasks while equipped with a particular Boots item, which is granted to you for free during its respective quest. Finish the following quests, which are assigned to you in a random order:

Quest - Berserker's Greaves: Basic attack 25 times.

Quest - Boots of Swiftness: Run 300 steps.

Quest - Ionian Boots of Lucidity: Cast 20 abilities.

Quest - Mercury's Treads: Become afflicted by crowd control 5 times.

Quest - Plated Steelcaps: Reduce a total of 200 damage with Plating.

Quest - Sorcerer's Shoes: Deal a total of 1500 damage with abilities.

Reward: Upon completing all of the above quests, you receive Jarvan I's.
