You cannot purchase any Boots items while equipped with this augment. If you already have a Boots item, it is replaced by the Boots granted by this effect. Boots items gained from this effect cannot be sold.

This augment is currently disabled.

2141.name: Ultra Hydra
2141.description:
你现在可以无视九头蛇的装备限制，购买提亚马特、亵渎九头蛇、贪欲九头蛇和巨型九头蛇。购买一件传说级九头蛇装备（挺进破坏者除外）时，免费获得一个提亚马特。

任务：获得亵渎九头蛇、贪欲九头蛇和巨型九头蛇。

奖励：完成任务后，将上述任务装备转化为终极九头蛇。
2141.sourceDescription:
You can now purchase Tiamat, Profane Hydra, Ravenous Hydra, and Titanic Hydra in spite of the item limit imposed by Hydra. Purchasing a Legendary-tier Hydra item (excluding Stridebreaker) grants you a Tiamat for free.

Quest: Obtain Profane Hydra, Ravenous Hydra, and Titanic Hydra.

Reward: Upon completing your Quest, convert the items you obtained for the quest into Ultra Hydra.

2034.name: Shark Tempest
2034.description:
标记（雪球）周围会有鲨鱼在 300 半径内环绕，飞行途中对经过的敌人造成 50 – 100（基于等级）魔法伤害，并使其减速 30%，持续 1 秒。若飞弹命中敌方英雄，鲨鱼改为在其位置周围 425 半径环绕，持续 3 秒，每秒对范围内敌人造成 25 – 75（基于等级）（+ 20% 额外攻击力）（+ 12% 法术强度）魔法伤害，并使其减速 30%，持续 3 秒。

若未携带标记，会提示你将一个召唤师技能替换为标记。
2034.sourceDescription:
Your Mark is empowered to circle sharks around it in a 300 radius, dealing 50 – 100 (based on level) magic damage to enemies it passes through as it travels and slowing targets hit by 30% for 1 second. If the missile hits an enemy champion, the sharks circle around their location in a 425 radius instead for 3 seconds, dealing「 25 – 75 (based on level) (+ 20% bonus AD) (+ 12% AP) magic damage every second 」to enemies within the area and slowing them by 30% for 3 seconds.

If Mark is not equipped, you will be prompted to replace one of your summoner spells with Mark.

1373.name: Shrink Engine
1373.description:
参与击杀英雄时获得一层效果，可无限叠加。每层提供 8 技能急速和 1% 额外移动速度，并使体型缩小 4%。死亡时失去 65% 层数。

体型缩小上限为 80%（20 层）。
1373.sourceDescription:
Scoring a champion takedown generates a stack, stacking infinitely. For each stack, gain 8 ability haste and 1% bonus movement speed, and reduce your size by 4%. Lose 65% of stacks on death.

Size reduction is capped at 80% (20 stacks).

2118.name: Ult Bot
2118.description: 你的技能急速现在只影响终极技能的冷却时间。作为交换，获得 100 技能急速，且技能急速和终极技能急速的效能提高 50%。
2118.sourceDescription: Your ability haste now only applies to the cooldown of your ultimate ability. In return, you gain 100 ability haste and your ability haste and ultimate haste are 50% more effective.

2109.name: Snap Back
2109.description:
升级你的一个英雄技能，为其提供再次施放效果。再次施放时，闪烁回该技能最初施放的位置，并引发爆炸，对附近敌人造成 100 – 300（基于等级）（+ 20% 攻击力）（+ 20% 法术强度）魔法伤害。

原文注明：此符文存在于内部符文数据中，但似乎已被禁用。
2109.sourceDescription:
Upgrades one of your champion's abilities, empowering the ability with a recast. Using the recast causes you to blink back to your original casting position of the ability and explode to deal 100 – 300 (based on level) (+ 20% AD) (+ 20% AP) magic damage to nearby enemies.

This augment exists in the internal augment data but appears to be disabled.

1334.name: Snowball Upgrade
1334.description:
标记（雪球）会在目标被命中的位置召唤持续 2 秒的暴风雪，提供区域视野，并在持续期间对范围内敌人造成总计 200（+ 200% 额外攻击力）（+ 120% 法术强度）魔法伤害，同时使其减速 50%（每 100 法术强度 + 6%）。此外，标记获得相当于 50 技能急速的冷却缩减。

若未携带标记，会提示你将一个召唤师技能替换为标记。

原文注明：此符文目前已禁用。
1334.sourceDescription:
Your Mark is empowered to hail a snowstorm at the location where the target was hit for 2 seconds, granting sight of the area and dealing「 200 (+ 200% bonus AD) (+ 120% AP) magic damage 」to enemies within over the duration, as well as slowing them by 50% (+ 6% per 100 AP). Additionally, your Mark's cooldown is reduced equivalent to 50 ability haste.

If Mark is not equipped, you will be prompted to replace one of your summoner spells with Mark.

This augment is currently disabled.

2080.name: Snowblast
2080.description:
强化标记（雪球）的突进技能，使其伤害提高 100%，抵达时将目标击飞 0.5 秒，并击退附近敌人。此外，标记获得相当于 100 技能急速的冷却缩减。

若未携带标记，会提示你将一个召唤师技能替换为标记。
2080.sourceDescription:
Empowers the Dash spell from Mark to deal 100% increased damage and upon arrival cause you to knock up the target for 0.5 seconds and knock back nearby enemies. Additionally, your Mark's cooldown is reduced equivalent to 100 ability haste.

If Mark is not equipped, you will be prompted to replace one of your summoner spells with Mark.

1420.name: Sonata
1420.description:
交替自动施放改版的娑娜坚毅咏叹调与迅捷奏鸣曲，先施放前者（冷却时间 10 秒）。

坚毅咏叹调：为你回复 60（+ 60% 法术强度）生命值，并向 1000 距离内受伤最重的友方英雄发出音波，回复相同生命值。此外，产生光环，为你和触碰光环的友方英雄提供可吸收 80（+ 40% 法术强度）伤害的护盾，持续 1.5 秒。

迅捷奏鸣曲：获得 30% 额外移动速度，持续 7 秒。若期间受到伤害，则在效果已持续或达到 3 秒时提前结束。此外，产生光环，为触碰光环的友方英雄提供 20% 额外移动速度，持续 3 秒。
1420.sourceDescription:
Alternate between automatically casting a modified version of Sona's Aria of Perseverance and modified Song of Celerity, with the former being cast first (10 second cooldown).

Aria of Perseverance: Heal yourself for 60 (+ 60% AP) and send out a tone to the most wounded allied champion within 1000 units that heals them for the same amount. Additionally, generate an aura that grants you and tagged allied champions a 80 (+ 40% AP) shield for 1.5 seconds.

Song of Celerity: Gain 30% bonus movement speed for 7 seconds. If you take damage during this time, the duration ends prematurely once or if 3 seconds have elapsed. Additionally, generate an aura that grants tagged allied champions 20% bonus movement speed for 3 seconds.

1375.name: Soul Eater
1375.description:
定身或缚地敌方英雄时，获得 20 额外生命值，可无限叠加（每次施法有 5 秒冷却时间）。

若此符文不是你的第一个符文，获得 300 额外生命值。
1375.sourceDescription:
Immobilizing or grounding an enemy champion grants you 20 bonus health, stacking infinitely (5 second cooldown per cast instance).

If this is not your first augment, gain 300 bonus health.

2116.name: Pursuit of Power
2116.description:
任务：用指定技能命中敌方英雄 10 次（每次施法对每名英雄最多计为 1 次命中）。

奖励：完成任务后，该技能伤害提高 30%。
2116.sourceDescription:
Quest: Hit an enemy champion with a specific ability 10 times (counts up to 1 hit per champion per cast instance).

Reward: Upon completing your Quest, increase the damage of the ability by 30%.

2054.name: Tripleshot
2054.description: 升级你的一个以单位为目标且发射飞弹的技能，使其额外向主要目标附近的两名敌人发射飞弹。同次施法对同一敌人的后续命中只造成 30% 伤害。
2054.sourceDescription: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities that is unit-targeted and fires a missile, empowering the ability to fire its missiles at two additional enemies near the primary target. Subsequent hits from the same cast against the same enemy deal 30% damage.

2115.name: Squishy Slappy Grab
2115.description: 当 450 距离内有敌方英雄时，延迟 1.5 秒后伸出黏糊糊的手，抓住周围 800 距离内的所有敌方英雄，在你与每个目标之间建立持续 4 秒的连线（冷却时间 35 秒）。连线保持期间（连线半径 950），下一次普通攻击会强化，将所有连线敌人拉向你，对其造成 30 – 100（基于等级）（+ 10% 额外生命值）魔法伤害，并在拉拽结束后晕眩 0.25 秒。目标被拉拽 450 距离，距离较远的目标则为 350。此外，每拉拽一名敌人，你获得可吸收 35 – 150（基于等级）（+ 50% 额外护甲）（+ 50% 额外魔法抗性）伤害的护盾。
2115.sourceDescription: When an enemy champion is within 450 units of you, after a 1.5-second delay, you send out Squishy Slappy Hands that latch onto all nearby enemy champions within 800 units, forming a tether between yourself and each target for 4 seconds (35 second cooldown). While the tethers persist (950 tether radius), your next basic attack is empowered to pull all tethered enemies toward you, dealing 30 – 100 (based on level) (+ 10% bonus health) magic damage to affected targets and stunning them for 0.25 seconds after the pull ends. Targets are pulled over 450 units, reduced to 350 for those farther away from you. Additionally, you gain a 35 – 150 (based on level) (+ 50% bonus armor) (+ 50% bonus magic resistance) shield for each pulled enemy.

2134.name: Surge Field
2134.description:
施放终极技能时，在脚下生成半径 300 的涌动区域。在区域内，你获得 50 技能急速和 40% 额外移动速度；对敌方英雄造成伤害会向其发射飞弹，额外造成相当于触发伤害减伤前数值 20% 的魔法伤害。飞弹效果不能触发自身。

只要你留在区域内，区域就会一直存在。第一次离开区域时，区域会移动到你的当前位置。第二次离开时，若未在 1.25 秒内重新进入，区域就会消失。
2134.sourceDescription:
Upon casting your ultimate ability, you spawn a surge zone beneath you that has a 300 radius. While you are within the zone, you gain 50 ability haste and 40% bonus movement speed, and your damage dealt to enemy champions fires missiles at them that deal 20% of the triggering damage instance pre-mitigation as bonus magic damage. The missile effect cannot trigger from itself.

The zone lasts indefinitely as long as you stay within its radius. If you leave the zone's radius for the first time, it moves to your current location. Exiting the zone a second time causes it to disappear if you do not re-enter the area within 1.25 seconds.

1315.name: Swift and Safe
1315.description: 冲刺或闪烁后，获得持续 2 秒的护盾，可吸收 65 – 290（基于等级）（+ 65% 攻击力）（+ 26% 法术强度）伤害（冷却时间 5 秒）。
1315.sourceDescription: After dashing or blinking, gain a shield that lasts for 2 seconds and absorbs 65 – 290 (based on level) (+ 65% AD) (+ 26% AP) damage (5 second cooldown).

2129.name: Terrain'd
2129.description: 升级你的一个会生成地形的技能，使其对地形附近敌人造成 20 – 180（基于等级）（+ 20% 法术强度）魔法伤害。若该技能是终极技能，伤害提高 200%。
2129.sourceDescription: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities that spawns terrain, empowering the ability to deal 20 – 180 (based on level) (+ 20% AP) magic damage to enemies near the terrain. This damage is increased「 by 200% 」if the ability is an ultimate.

2076.name: Stay Resolute
2076.description:
升级你的一个英雄技能，使其对敌方英雄造成伤害时永久提供 1 / 2 / 3（基于等级）额外护甲或额外魔法抗性，可无限叠加（每次施法对每个目标有 5 秒冷却时间）。

提供的抗性类型取决于目标的自适应属性：物理类型提供额外护甲，魔法类型提供额外魔法抗性。

若此符文不是你的第一个符文，获得 20 额外护甲和额外魔法抗性。
2076.sourceDescription:
Upgrades one of your champion's abilities, empowering the ability to grant you 1 / 2 / 3 (based on level) bonus armor or bonus magic resistance permanently when it damages an enemy champion, stacking infinitely (5 second cooldown per target per cast instance).

The resistance type granted is based on the target's adaptive type: bonus armor for physical and bonus magic resistance for magic.

If this is not your first augment, gain 20 bonus armor and bonus magic resistance.

2136.name: Trusty Weapon
2136.description: 升级你的一个英雄技能，使其命中敌方英雄时获得一层友谊，持续 6 秒。每层友谊使该技能造成的伤害提高 5%。此效果可叠加若干层。
2136.sourceDescription: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities, empowering the ability to generate a Friendship stack for 6 seconds when it hits an enemy champion. For each Friendship stack you have, the ability deals 5% increased damage. This effect can stack up to a number of times.

1415.name: Twin Fire
1415.description: 伤害技能命中敌方英雄时，向目标发射 1（每 33.33% 暴击几率 + 1）枚飞弹，每枚造成 10 – 30（基于等级）（+ 7% 额外攻击力）（+ 7% 法术强度）魔法伤害（冷却时间 5 秒）。此外，获得 25% 暴击几率。
1415.sourceDescription: Damaging abilities against enemy champions launch 1 (+ 1 per 33.33% critical strike chance) missiles at the target that each deal 10 – 30 (based on level) (+ 7% bonus AD) (+ 7% AP) magic damage (5 second cooldown). Additionally, gain 25% critical strike chance.

1349.name: Ultimate Awakening
1349.description: 施放终极技能会重置所有基础技能的冷却时间，并提供 300 基础技能急速，持续 15 秒（冷却时间 20 秒）。此外，获得 30 终极技能急速。
1349.sourceDescription: Casting your ultimate ability resets the cooldowns of all your basic abilities and grants you 300 basic ability haste for 15 seconds (20 second cooldown). Additionally, gain 30 ultimate haste.

2157.name: Upgrade Death's Dance
2157.description: 升级死亡之舞：无视痛苦的伤害减免提高至近战 40% / 远程 15%，蔑视的治疗攻击力系数提高至 125% 额外攻击力。蔑视的治疗也改为被动触发时立即生效，而不是在 2 秒内逐步回复。此外，获得 250 金币。
2157.sourceDescription: Upgrades Death's Dance, empowering Ignore Pain with an increased damage reduction of (melee 40% / ranged 15%) and Defy with an increased heal AD ratio of 125% bonus AD. Defy's healing is also granted instantly upon the passive effect being triggered rather than over 2 seconds. Additionally, gain gold 250.

2140.name: Upgrade Ravenous Hydra
2140.description: 升级贪欲九头蛇，将生命偷取属性提高至 20%，并使顺劈在技能命中敌人时也触发（每个技能的冷却时间为 1 秒）。此外，获得 500 金币。
2140.sourceDescription: Upgrades Ravenous Hydra, increasing its life steal stat to 20% and empowering Cleave to trigger its effect on ability hits against enemies (1 second cooldown per ability). Additionally, gain gold 500.

2143.name: Upgrade Sundered Sky
2143.description: 升级焚天，将光盾打击的已损失生命值治疗系数提高至 9%，冷却时间缩短至 5 秒。此外，获得 500 金币。
2143.sourceDescription: Upgrades Sundered Sky, empowering Lightshield Strike with an increased heal health ratio of 9% of your missing health and a reduced cooldown of 5 seconds. Additionally, gain gold 500.

1379.name: Upgrade Sword of Blossoming Dawn
1379.description: 升级绽放黎明之剑，将薄荷的治疗量提高 250%。此外，获得 100% 额外攻击速度。
1379.sourceDescription: Upgrades Sword of Blossoming Dawn, empowering Peppermint to have its healing increased by 250%. Additionally, you gain 100% bonus attack speed.

1346.name: Vampirism
1346.description:
你无法再受到友军治疗，生命回复设为 0。获得 25% 全能吸血。

原文注明：此符文目前已禁用。
1346.sourceDescription:
You can no longer be healed by allies and your health regeneration is set to 0. Gain 25% omnivamp.

This augment is currently disabled.

1034.name: Veil of Warding
1034.description: 获得法术护盾，格挡下一次敌方技能（冷却时间 30 秒；受到英雄伤害不会重新开始计时）。
1034.sourceDescription: Grants a spell shield that blocks the next hostile ability (30 second cooldown, timer does not restart from champion damage taken).

2097.name: Void Dash
2097.description:
升级你的一个带有冲刺效果的技能，使其在冲刺终点延迟 0.3 秒后生成半径 250 的虚空区域。区域内敌方英雄受到 80 – 400（基于等级）（+ 100% 技能急速）魔法伤害，并被减速 35%，持续 1 秒。

原文注明：此符文目前已禁用。
2097.sourceDescription:
Upgrades one of your champion's abilities that has a dash, empowering the ability to spawn a void zone (250 radius) at the dash's destination after a 0.3-second delay. Enemy champions within the zone are dealt 80 – 400 (based on level) (+ 100% ability haste) magic damage and are slowed by 35% for 1 second.

This augment is currently disabled.

2138.name: Adaptive Ward
2138.description:
升级你的一个英雄技能，使其命中敌方英雄时提供 7 – 12（基于等级）额外护甲或额外魔法抗性，持续 6 秒（冷却时间 4 秒）。此效果可叠加若干层。

提供的抗性类型取决于目标的自适应属性：物理类型提供额外护甲，魔法类型提供额外魔法抗性。
2138.sourceDescription:
Upgrades one of your champion's abilities, empowering the ability to grant you 7 – 12 (based on level) bonus armor or bonus magic resistance for 6 seconds when it hits an enemy champion (4 second cooldown). This effect can stack up to a number of times.

The resistance type granted is based on the target's adaptive type: bonus armor for physical and bonus magic resistance for magic.

2132.name: Warlock Juicebox
2132.description: 获得 10%（每 100 法术强度 + 3%）全能吸血。

1386.name: Spin Me Right Round
1386.description:
将一个召唤师技能替换为阿克尚的骄行荡寇（冷却时间 10 秒，从效果结束后开始计算）。

骄行荡寇——主动：技能进入冷却前可以施放三次，第三次只能在第二次施放至少 0.5 秒后使用。可通过攻击或移动指令执行第二次和第三次施放。

第一次施放：向目标方向发射钩索，附着在命中的第一处地形上，持续 2 秒。钩索附着期间可以进行第二次施放。若钩索未能附着，或期间受到定身、缚地或变形，技能会取消并进入完整冷却。

第二次施放：根据鼠标相对于你面朝方向的位置，绕地形顺时针或逆时针摆荡，撞到敌方英雄或地形时停止。摆荡期间，每 0.231 秒向攻击距离内（最低 400）的最近可见敌人射击，造成 15 – 75（基于等级）（+ 15% 攻击力）×（1 + 每 100% 额外攻击速度提供 0.3）物理伤害，每发施加攻击特效，其中攻击特效伤害的效能降至 25%。冲刺期间受到定身或变形控制时，冲刺会被打断。

第三次施放：跳向目标位置以结束摆荡，并向附近可见敌人发射最后一枪。
1386.sourceDescription:
Replace a summoner spell with Akshan's Heroic Swing (10 second cooldown, starts post-effect).

Heroic Swing - Active: You can activate Heroic Swing three times before the ability goes on cooldown, and you can use the third cast only after 0.5 seconds of the second cast. An attack or movement command may be inputted to use the second and third casts.

First Cast: Fire a hook in the target direction that embeds in the first terrain hit for 2 seconds. Heroic Swing's second cast can be used while the hook is attached. If the hook fails to attach or you become immobilized, grounded, or polymorphed within the duration, Heroic Swing is cancelled and placed on full cooldown.

Second Cast: Swing around the terrain in either a clockwise or counterclockwise direction based on the position of the cursor relative to your facing direction, stopping upon colliding with an enemy champion or terrain. While swinging, fire at the nearest visible enemy within your attack range (minimum 400 units) every 0.231 seconds to deal them 15 – 75 (based on level) (+ 15% AD) × (1 + 0.3 per 100% bonus attack speed) physical damage and apply on-hit effects for each shot, with on-hit damage reduced to 25% effectiveness. The dash will be interrupted if you are affected by any immobilizing or polymorphing crowd control during the dash.

Third Cast: End the swing by jumping to the target location and fire one last shot at a nearby visible enemy.
